def sha(data):
    return hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()


def replace_one(text, before, after, label):
    if text.count(before) != 1:
        raise ValueError(label + " needs the current source join; found " + str(text.count(before)) + " anchors")
    return text.replace(before, after, 1)


def native_dispatch(text, *, retention=False):
    """Compose either the original run or the exact ECO-RUN12 retained wrapper."""
    retained = ('        if action == "run.start":\n'
                '            from ecsa_runs.upstate import invoke_original_run\n'
                '            return invoke_original_run(self, task, ws, required(value, "run_id"))\n')
    original = ('        if action == "run.start":\n'
                '            return ws.run(required(value, "run_id"))\n')
    if retained in text:
        return replace_one(text, retained,
            '        if action == "run.start":\n'
            '            return self.native_jobs.execute_retained(task, ws)\n',
            "retained native run composition")
    if original in text:
        call = "execute_retained" if retention else "execute"
        return replace_one(text, original,
            '        if action == "run.start":\n'
            '            return self.native_jobs.' + call + '(task, ws)\n',
            "native run dispatch")
    if text.count("return self.native_jobs.execute(task, ws)") == 1:
        return (replace_one(text, "return self.native_jobs.execute(task, ws)",
                            "return self.native_jobs.execute_retained(task, ws)",
                            "retention around existing supervision") if retention else text)
    if text.count("return self.native_jobs.execute_retained(task, ws)") == 1:
        return text
    raise ValueError("The current native run dispatch needs its retained/supervised source join")


def programme_server_patch(text):
    previous_cursor = 'expected_run=one("run_id", "")))'
    current_cursor = ('expected_run=one("run_id", ""), '
                      'expected_execution=one("execution_id", "")))')
    if previous_cursor in text:
        text = replace_one(text, previous_cursor, current_cursor,
                           "same-run process log continuation")
    substitutions = (
        ('if task["action"] == "run.start" and task["state"] != "queued":',
         'if self.native_jobs.supports(task) and task["state"] != "queued":'),
        ('if task["action"] == "run.start":\n            task["_native_job"] = self.native_jobs.snapshot(task)',
         'if self.native_jobs.supports(task):\n            try:\n                task["_native_job"] = self.native_jobs.snapshot(task)\n            except NativeJobError as error:\n                if error.code != "PROGRAMME_PREPARING":\n                    raise'),
        ('stream=one("stream", "native"), offset=one("offset", "0")))',
         'stream=one("stream", "native"), offset=one("offset", "0"),\n'

            raise ValueError("The current operator needs its programme supervision registration")
    ast.parse(text)

def programme_patch(text):
    original = '            result = manager.resume(key, only_runs=payload.get("only_runs"))\n'
    joined = ('            # ' + MARKER + ' programme execution\n'
              '            result = self.operator.native_jobs.execute_programme(\n'
              '                task, manager, key, only_runs=payload.get("only_runs"))\n')

    pair = '            result = manager.create_pair_completion(key, expected_preview_id=payload.get("expected_preview_id"))\n'
    pinned = ('            result = self.operator.native_jobs.create_pair_completion(\n'
              '                task, manager, key, expected_preview_id=payload.get("expected_preview_id"))\n')

        text = replace_one(text, pair, pinned, "original paired task preview binding")
    elif "compute.programme.pair-completion" in text and pinned not in text:
        raise ValueError("The current paired completion creation needs its original task preview join")
    ast.parse(text)

def builtin_route_patch(text):
    """Register the native route in the existing extension collision check."""
    keywords = [node for node in ast.walk(ast.parse(text))
                if isinstance(node, ast.keyword) and node.arg == "builtin_routes"]
    if len(keywords) != 1:
        raise ValueError("The current extension registry needs its native route join")
    node = keywords[0].value
    routes = ast.literal_eval(node)
    if not isinstance(routes, (tuple, list)):
        raise ValueError("The original built-in routes must remain a literal sequence")
    route = ("GET", "/api/native-job")
    count = routes.count(route)
    if count == 1:
        return text
    if count:
        raise ValueError("The native built-in route is registered more than once")
    updated = [*routes, route]
    replacement = repr(tuple(updated) if isinstance(routes, tuple) else updated)
    segment = ast.get_source_segment(text, node)
    if not segment:
        raise ValueError("The original built-in route registry has no source span")
    return replace_one(text, segment, replacement, "native built-in route registration")


def native_import_patch(text):
    """Put the original operator path before a retained supervision import."""
    operator_path = "sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parent))\n"
    native_import = ("from native_jobs import NativeJobs, NativeJobError, "
                     "NativeJobCancelled, NativeJobDetached\n")
    if text.count(native_import) != 1:
        raise ValueError("The retained native import needs its current operator path join")
    if operator_path in text and text.index(operator_path) < text.index(native_import):
        return text
    import_block = "# " + MARKER + "\n" + native_import
    if text.count(import_block) != 1:
        raise ValueError("The retained native import has no exact authored registration")
    return replace_one(text, import_block, operator_path + import_block,
                       "retained native import ordering")


def server_patch(text, *, retention=False):
    text = builtin_route_patch(text)
    if "# " + MARKER in text:
        required = ("self.native_jobs = NativeJobs(self)",
                    '"/api/native-job"', "jobs.mjs", "NativeJobCancelled")
        if any(token not in text for token in required):
            raise ValueError("A partial native supervision registration needs its current source join")
        previous = '            final_state = "cancelled" if isinstance(error, NativeJobCancelled) else "failed"\n'

def atomic_write(path, body, mode=0o644):
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    pending = None
    try:
        with tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(dir=path.parent, prefix=".native-install-", delete=False) as out:
            pending = Path(out.name)
            os.fchmod(out.fileno(), mode)
            out.write(body)
            out.flush()
            os.fsync(out.fileno())
        os.replace(pending, path)
        pending = None
        fd = os.open(path.parent, os.O_RDONLY | os.O_DIRECTORY)
        try:
            os.fsync(fd)
        finally:
            os.close(fd)
    finally:
        if pending:
            pending.unlink(missing_ok=True)

def parameter_result_server_patch(source):
    """Compose current query fields and assets without narrowing peer routes."""
    tree = ast.parse(source, filename="operator/server.py")
    calls = [node for node in ast.walk(tree)
             if isinstance(node, ast.Call) and isinstance(node.func, ast.Attribute)
             and node.func.attr == "read" and isinstance(node.func.value, ast.Attribute)
             and node.func.value.attr == "parameter_studies"
             and len(node.args) >= 3 and isinstance(node.args[1], ast.Subscript)
             and isinstance(node.args[1].value, ast.Name)
             and node.args[1].value.id == "parameter_study_reads"]
    if len(calls) != 1 or len(calls[0].args) < 3:
        raise ValueError("Parameter results: expected one maintained native read dispatcher.")
    query = calls[0].args[2]
    retained = {node.value for node in ast.walk(query)
                if isinstance(node, ast.Constant) and isinstance(node.value, str)}
    missing = [name for name in PARAMETER_QUERY_KEYS if name not in retained]
    if missing:
        # AST column positions are UTF-8 bytes. Preserve any preceding Unicode
        # and every unknown peer query field exactly.
        raw = source.encode("utf-8")
        lines = raw.splitlines(keepends=True)
        start = sum(map(len, lines[:query.lineno - 1])) + query.col_offset
        end = sum(map(len, lines[:query.end_lineno - 1])) + query.end_col_offset
        original = raw[start:end].decode("utf-8")
        fields = ", ".join(json.dumps(name) + ": one(" + json.dumps(name) + ")"
                           for name in missing)
        replacement = "(" + original + " | {" + fields + "})"
        source = (raw[:start] + replacement.encode("utf-8") + raw[end:]).decode("utf-8")
    matches = list(re.finditer(r"if selected not in (\(*)(\{[^}\n]+\})([^:\n]*):", source))
    if len(matches) != 1:
        raise ValueError("Parameter results: expected the maintained static asset registry.")
    match = matches[0]
    members = ast.literal_eval(match.group(2))
    if not isinstance(members, set) or not all(isinstance(item, str) for item in members):
        raise ValueError("Parameter results: expected the original literal asset set.")
    required_assets = {"parameter_case_console.mjs", "parameter_studies.mjs", "parameter_studies.css"}
    if not required_assets <= members:
        members.update(required_assets)
        literal = "{" + ", ".join(json.dumps(item) for item in sorted(members)) + "}"
        source = (source[:match.start(2)] + literal + source[match.end(2):])
    ast.parse(source, filename="operator/server.py")
    return source

def ensemble_parameter_core_patch(body, ledger_body):
    """Compose only the published additive continuation into retained science."""
    ledger = json.loads(ledger_body.decode("utf-8"))
    if (ledger.get("schema") != "upstate.ensemble-parameter-core-joins/v1" or
            ledger.get("path") != "model/parameter_studies.py"):
        raise ValueError("Receive the exact original Ensemble continuation source-join ledger.")
    joins = ledger.get("replacements")
    if (not isinstance(joins, list) or len(joins) != 4 or
            any(not isinstance(item, dict) or
                not isinstance(item.get("before"), str) or not item["before"] or
                not isinstance(item.get("after"), str) or not item["after"]
                for item in joins)):
        raise ValueError("The original Ensemble continuation needs its four exact source joins.")
    text = body.decode("utf-8")
    ast.parse(text, filename="model/parameter_studies.py")
    if ("def prepare_retained(" in text and joins[0]["after"] not in text):
        raise ValueError("Compose the existing retained-case implementation before receiving its continuation.")
    applied = []
    for index, item in enumerate(joins):
        before, after = item["before"], item["after"]
        count = text.count(after)
        if count == 1:
            applied.append({"join": index + 1, "state": "already_composed"})
            continue
        if count:
            raise ValueError("Ambiguous original Ensemble continuation postimage: " + str(index + 1))
        text = replace_one(text, before, after,
                           "retained scientific continuation join " + str(index + 1))
        applied.append({"join": index + 1, "state": "composed"})
    ast.parse(text, filename="model/parameter_studies.py")
    result = text.encode("utf-8")
    if sha(body) == ledger.get("base_sha256"):
        if len(body) != ledger.get("base_bytes"):
            raise ValueError("The original scientific source size differs from its ledger.")
        if sha(result) != ledger.get("sha256") or len(result) != ledger.get("bytes"):
            raise ValueError("The composed scientific source differs from its exact published postimage.")
    return result, {"ledger_sha256": sha(ledger_body), "before_sha256": sha(body),
                    "after_sha256": sha(result), "joins": applied,

        atomic_write(backup / "installation.json", (json.dumps(receipt, indent=2) + "\n").encode())

"""Run one original Workspace calculation in a recoverable Linux process."""
from __future__ import annotations
import argparse
import contextlib
import hashlib
import os
from pathlib import Path
import signal
import sys
import threading
import time
import traceback

from .common import atomic_json, digest, file_digest, held, identifier, now, read_json
from .native_execution import resource_status

SCHEMA = "upstate.native-worker-request/v1"


def process_identity(pid=None):
    """Identity survives reconnect and rejects a recycled PID or namespace."""
    pid = os.getpid() if pid is None else int(pid)
    row = Path("/proc") / str(pid)
    try:
        stat = (row / "stat").read_text().rsplit(")", 1)[1].split()
        if stat[0] in {"Z", "X"}:
            return None
        return {"pid": pid, "start_ticks": stat[19],
                "boot_id": Path("/proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id").read_text().strip(),
                "command_sha256": hashlib.sha256((row / "cmdline").read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
                "process_group": os.getpgid(pid)}
    except (OSError, ValueError, IndexError, ProcessLookupError):
        return None


def identity_matches(expected):
    current = process_identity(expected.get("pid", -1))
    return bool(current and all(current.get(k) == expected.get(k)
                                for k in ("pid", "start_ticks", "boot_id", "process_group", "command_sha256"))
                and current["process_group"] == current["pid"])


def signal_owned(directory, identity, execution_id, request_sha256, signum):
    """Share signal receipts between a connected supervisor and its detached worker."""
    directory = Path(directory)
    with held(directory / ".stop.lock"):
        receipt = directory / ("signal-" + str(int(signum)) + ".json")
        if receipt.exists() or not identity_matches(identity):
            return False
        atomic_json(receipt, {"execution_id": execution_id,
                             "request_sha256": request_sha256,
                             "signal_requested": int(signum), "at": now(),
                             "identity": identity}, immutable=True)
        os.killpg(identity["process_group"], signum)
        return True


class NativeStop(BaseException):
    pass


def run_request(request_path):
    request_path = Path(request_path).resolve(strict=True)
    request = read_json(request_path)
    if request.get("schema") != SCHEMA:
        raise ValueError("Choose an original native worker request")
    run_id = identifier(request["run_id"])
    execution_id = identifier(request["execution_id"])
    workspace_path = Path(request["workspace"]).resolve(strict=True)
    directory = workspace_path / "runs" / run_id / "supervision" / execution_id
    if request_path != directory / "request.json":
        raise ValueError("The worker request is outside its selected native run")
    if request.get("request_sha256") != digest({k: v for k, v in request.items()
                                              if k != "request_sha256"}):
        raise ValueError("The retained native request changed")

    application = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
    for name, expected in request.get("application_source", {}).items():
        path = (application / name).resolve(strict=True)
        if not path.is_relative_to(application) or file_digest(path) != expected:
            raise ValueError("The native worker application source changed: " + name)
    from .workspace import Workspace
    workspace = Workspace(workspace_path)
    state = workspace.inspect_run(run_id)
    if state["selection"] != request["selection"]:
        raise ValueError("The native run selection differs from the retained worker request")
    if workspace.project["id"] != request["project_id"]:
        raise ValueError("The native request belongs to a different project")

    context = request.get("programme_context")
    if context:
        from .compute_programme import ComputeProgrammes
        programme = ComputeProgrammes(workspace)._load(identifier(context["programme_id"]))
        bindings = [row for row in programme["runs"] if row["run_id"] == run_id]
        if (context.get("run_id") != run_id or not bindings
                or digest(bindings) != context.get("bindings_sha256")
                or any(row["native_selection"] != request["selection"] for row in bindings)):
            raise ValueError("The worker run differs from its original programme binding")

    study_context = request.get("study_context")
    if study_context:
        from .parameter_studies import native_case_context
        checked = native_case_context(workspace, identifier(study_context["study_id"]), run_id)
        if checked != study_context:
            raise ValueError("The native worker differs from its original saved parameter case")

    stopped = threading.Event()
    identity = process_identity()
    if not identity or identity["process_group"] != os.getpid():
        raise ValueError("The native worker needs its own Linux process group")
    started = time.monotonic()
    worker = {"schema": "upstate.native-worker/v1", "execution_id": execution_id,
              "run_id": run_id, "task_id": request["task_id"],
              "request_sha256": request["request_sha256"], "started_at": now(),
              "identity": identity, "python": sys.version.split()[0],
              "workspace": str(workspace_path), "resources": resource_status()}

    def interrupt(signum, frame):
        raise NativeStop("The operator requested a stop of this calculation")

    signal.signal(signal.SIGINT, interrupt)
    signal.signal(signal.SIGTERM, interrupt)

    def heartbeat():
        first_stop = None
        sent = set()
        while not stopped.is_set():
            with contextlib.suppress(OSError):
                atomic_json(directory / "heartbeat.json", {
                    "schema": "upstate.native-heartbeat/v1", "execution_id": execution_id,
                    "at": now(), "elapsed_seconds": time.monotonic() - started,
                    "identity": identity, "resources": resource_status()})
            stop_path = directory / "stop.json"
            if stop_path.exists():
                try:
                    stop = read_json(stop_path)
                    selected = (stop.get("execution_id") == execution_id
                                and stop.get("request_sha256") == request["request_sha256"])
                except (OSError, ValueError):
                    selected = False
                if selected:
                    if first_stop is None:
                        first_stop = time.monotonic()
                        with contextlib.suppress(OSError):
                            atomic_json(directory / "stop-acknowledged.json", {
                                "execution_id": execution_id, "at": now(),
                                "request_sha256": request["request_sha256"]})
                    elapsed = time.monotonic() - first_stop
                    stage = signal.SIGKILL if elapsed >= 30 else signal.SIGTERM if elapsed >= 15 else signal.SIGINT
                    if stage not in sent:
                        sent.add(stage)
                        # This process owns the fresh session and every signaled child.
                        with contextlib.suppress(ProcessLookupError):
                            signal_owned(directory, identity, execution_id, request["request_sha256"], stage)
            stopped.wait(1)

    with held(directory / ".worker.lock", blocking=False):
        atomic_json(directory / "worker.json", worker, immutable=True)
        ticker = threading.Thread(target=heartbeat, name="native-worker-heartbeat", daemon=True)
        try:
            ticker.start()
            print("Starting original native run " + run_id, flush=True)
            result = workspace.run(run_id)
            if result.get("id") != run_id or result.get("state") != "complete":
                raise ValueError("The original native calculation did not complete")
            atomic_json(directory / "result.json", {
                "schema": "upstate.native-worker-result/v1", "execution_id": execution_id,
                "request_sha256": request["request_sha256"], "completed_at": now(),
                "elapsed_seconds": time.monotonic() - started, "result": result})
            print("Original native run completed " + run_id, flush=True)
            return 0
        except BaseException as error:
            is_stop = isinstance(error, (NativeStop, KeyboardInterrupt))
            detail = {"schema": "upstate.native-worker-failure/v1", "execution_id": execution_id,
                      "request_sha256": request["request_sha256"], "at": now(),
                      "elapsed_seconds": time.monotonic() - started,
                      "stopped": is_stop, "type": type(error).__name__, "message": str(error)}
            with contextlib.suppress(OSError):
                atomic_json(directory / "failure.json", detail)
                (directory / "error.txt").write_text(traceback.format_exc(), encoding="utf-8")
            print(("Stopped" if is_stop else "Failed") + " original native run: " + str(error), flush=True)
            return 130 if is_stop else 1
        finally:
            stopped.set()
            ticker.join(timeout=2)
            with contextlib.suppress(OSError):
                atomic_json(directory / "finished.json", {
                    "execution_id": execution_id, "at": now(),
                    "elapsed_seconds": time.monotonic() - started,
                    "request_sha256": request["request_sha256"]})


def main(argv=None):
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("--request", required=True)
    args = parser.parse_args(argv)
    return run_request(args.request)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())

                or not isinstance(failure, dict) or failure.get("run_id") != run["id"]
                or failure.get("completed_result_retained") is not True
                or type(failure.get("return_code")) is not int or failure["return_code"] >= 0
                or not isinstance(process, dict)
                or process.get("execution_id") != request["execution_id"]
                or process.get("request_sha256") != request["request_sha256"]):
            raise ValueError("The retained completed-worker interruption differs from its original request")
    records["completed_interruption"] = interruption
    worker = records["worker"] or records["launch"] or {}
    identity = worker.get("identity")
    alive = bool(isinstance(identity, dict) and identity_matches(identity))
    supervision = records["supervision"] or {}
    failure = records["failure"] or {}
    result = records["result"]
    if result and (result.get("result", {}).get("id") != run["id"]
                   or result["result"].get("selection") != run["selection"]
                   or result["result"].get("state") != "complete"):
        raise ValueError("The saved worker result differs from this original native case")
    # Process history survives a later successful verification of the same result.
    # The native result and latest supervision remain separately available.
    original_failure = interruption["error"] if interruption is not None else None
    status = ("interrupted_after_completion" if original_failure else
              "complete" if result else "running" if alive else
              supervision.get("state") or ("failed" if failure else "ended_without_receipt"))
    heartbeat = records["heartbeat"] or {}
    resources = None
    for label, record in (("worker heartbeat", heartbeat), ("worker start", worker)):
        if (record.get("identity") == identity and isinstance(record.get("resources"), dict)):
            resources = {"source": label, "observed_at": record.get("at") or record.get("started_at"),
                         "values": record["resources"]}
            break
    return {"id": "worker:" + directory.name, "kind": "operator_worker",
            "created_at": request.get("created_at"), "state": status, "alive": alive,
            "pid": (identity or {}).get("pid", worker.get("pid")),
            "task_id": request.get("task_id"), "execution_id": request["execution_id"],
            "request_sha256": request["request_sha256"],
            "request_body_sha256": file_digest(directory / "request.json"),
            "return_code": (original_failure["return_code"] if original_failure
                            else supervision.get("returncode")),
            "error": original_failure or supervision.get("error") or failure or None,
            "completed_result_retained": bool(result),
            "latest_supervision_state": supervision.get("state"),
            "resources": resources, "request": request, "records": records,
            "directory": directory.relative_to(workspace.root).as_posix(),
            "logs": {"process": "process.log"}}


def _isolated_receipt(workspace, directory, name, run_id, request_sha256, pid=None):
    value = _json(workspace, directory, name)
    if value is None:
        return None
    if (value.get("run_id") != run_id
            or value.get("request_sha256", request_sha256) != request_sha256
            or (pid is not None and value.get("pid", pid) != pid)):
        raise ValueError("The retained isolated-process receipt belongs to another case: " + name)
    return value


def _isolated(workspace, run, directory):
    request = _json(workspace, directory, "request.json", optional=False)
    if (request.get("schema") != "upstate.gura-isolated-native-case/v1"
            or request.get("workspace_id") != workspace.project["id"]
            or request.get("run_id") != run["id"]):
        raise ValueError("The retained Gura process selects another original native case")
    # Resolve the physical location within this Workspace; retain the original
    # request's absolute path as provenance after a portable restore.
    sha256 = file_digest(relative_file(
        workspace.root, (directory / "request.json").relative_to(workspace.root).as_posix()))
    process = _isolated_receipt(workspace, directory, "process.json", run["id"], sha256)
    pid = (process or {}).get("pid")
    returned = _isolated_receipt(workspace, directory, "return.json", run["id"], sha256, pid)
    interruption = _json(workspace, directory, "interruption.json")
    if interruption and (interruption.get("run_id") != run["id"]
                         or interruption.get("process", {}).get("request_sha256", sha256) != sha256
                         or (pid is not None and interruption.get("process", {}).get("pid") != pid)):
        raise ValueError("The saved Gura interruption differs from its original process")
    code = returned.get("return_code") if returned else None
    status = ("interrupted" if interruption else
              "returned" if returned else "awaiting_return_receipt")
    resources = None
    if returned and isinstance(returned.get("resources_after"), dict):
        resources = {"source": "isolated-process supervisor after return",
                     "observed_at": returned.get("returned_at"),
                     "values": returned["resources_after"]}
    return {"id": "isolated:" + directory.name, "kind": "gura_isolated",
            "created_at": request.get("created_at"), "state": status, "alive": None,
            "pid": pid, "return_code": code, "error": interruption,
            "request_sha256": sha256, "request_body_sha256": sha256,
            "resources": resources, "request": request,
            "records": {"process": process, "return": returned, "interruption": interruption},
            "directory": directory.relative_to(workspace.root).as_posix(),
            "logs": {"stdout": "stdout.log", "stderr": "stderr.log"}}


def _attempts(workspace, run):
    result = []
    roots = (("worker", workspace.root / "runs" / run["id"] / "supervision", 64, _supervised),
             ("isolated", workspace.root / "gura-receiving" / "native-case-processes" / run["id"],
              32, _isolated))
    for prefix, root, length, reader in roots:
        for path in root.glob("*/request.json"):
            if not re.fullmatch("[0-9a-f]{" + str(length) + "}", path.parent.name):
                continue
            key = prefix + ":" + path.parent.name
            try:
                record = reader(workspace, run, path.parent)
                result.append(record)
            except (OSError, ValueError, KeyError, TypeError) as error:
                result.append({"id": key, "kind": prefix, "state": "unavailable",
                               "created_at": None, "error": {"type": type(error).__name__,
                                                           "message": str(error)}})
    return sorted(result, key=lambda row: (row.get("created_at") or "", row["id"]), reverse=True)


def _coordinator_active(workspace):
    """Observe the maintained batch lease without creating or changing its file."""
    path = workspace.root / ".native-model-batch.lock"
    if not path.exists():
        return False
    try:
        import fcntl
        fd = os.open(path, os.O_RDONLY | os.O_NOFOLLOW)
        try:
            try:
                fcntl.flock(fd, fcntl.LOCK_EX | fcntl.LOCK_NB)
                return False
            except BlockingIOError:
                return True
        finally:
            os.close(fd)
    except (ImportError, OSError):
        return None


def _page_number(value, name, default, *, maximum=None):
    if value in (None, ""):
        return default
    if isinstance(value, bool):
        raise ValueError(name + " must be a nonnegative whole number")
    try:
        number = int(value)
    except (ValueError, TypeError, OverflowError):
        raise ValueError(name + " must be a nonnegative whole number") from None
    if number < 0 or str(number) != str(value) or (maximum is not None and number > maximum):
        raise ValueError(name + " must be a nonnegative whole number"
                         + (" no greater than " + str(maximum) if maximum is not None else ""))
    return number


def _log(workspace, run_id, attempt, stream, offset, expected_attempt):
    streams = {"native": "runs/" + run_id + "/native.log"}
    if attempt and attempt.get("directory"):
        streams.update({name: attempt["directory"] + "/" + filename
                        for name, filename in attempt["logs"].items()})
    selected = stream or "native"
    selected_id = attempt["id"] if attempt else None
    reset = bool(expected_attempt and expected_attempt != selected_id)
    if selected not in streams:
        if reset:
            selected = "native"
        else:
            raise ValueError("Choose a log stream retained by this original attempt")
    start = None if reset else _page_number(offset, "Log offset", None)
    relative = streams[selected]
    if not (workspace.root / relative).exists():
        return {"stream": selected, "attempt_id": selected_id, "path": relative,
                "bytes": 0, "offset": 0, "next_offset": 0, "text": "", "reset": reset,
                "available_streams": list(streams)}
    path = relative_file(workspace.root, relative)
    with path.open("rb") as incoming:
        length = os.fstat(incoming.fileno()).st_size
        if start is None:
            start = max(0, length - 65536)
        elif start > length:
            start, reset = 0, True
        incoming.seek(start)
        body = incoming.read(65536)
    return {"stream": selected, "attempt_id": selected_id, "path": relative,
            "bytes": length, "offset": start, "next_offset": start + len(body),
            "text": body.decode("utf-8", "replace"), "reset": reset,
            "available_streams": list(streams)}


def read_run(workspace, run_id, *, attempt_id=None, stream="native",
             log_offset=None, expected_attempt_id=None, history_offset=0, limit=25):
    """Read the common original native receipts after the caller binds its case."""
    run_id = identifier(run_id)
    native = inspect_execution(workspace, run_id, log_bytes=0)
    run = workspace.inspect_run(run_id)
    records = _attempts(workspace, run)
    chosen = (next((record for record in records if record["id"] == attempt_id), None)
              if attempt_id else next((record for record in records
                                       if record["state"] != "unavailable"), None))
    if attempt_id and chosen is None:
        raise ValueError("Choose an attempt retained for this original native case")
    if chosen and chosen["state"] == "unavailable":
        raise ValueError(chosen["error"]["message"])
    offset = _page_number(history_offset, "Attempt offset", 0)
    size = _page_number(limit, "Attempt page size", 25, maximum=100)
    if size == 0:
        raise ValueError("Attempt page size must be positive")
    offset = min(offset, max(0, ((len(records) - 1) // size) * size))
    columns = ("id", "kind", "created_at", "state", "alive", "pid", "task_id",
               "execution_id", "return_code", "request_sha256", "error",
               "completed_result_retained", "latest_supervision_state")
    history = [{name: row.get(name) for name in columns}
               for row in records[offset:offset + size]]
    return {"schema": "upstate.native-case-attempts/v1", "workspace_id": workspace.project["id"],
            "coordinator_active": _coordinator_active(workspace), "native": native,
            "attempt": chosen, "history": {"offset": offset, "limit": size,
                                           "total": len(records), "rows": history},
            "log": _log(workspace, run_id, chosen, stream, log_offset, expected_attempt_id),
            "resource_basis": "Saved observations retain their original observing process. "
                              "Cgroup counters include other processes; a group event does not identify its victim."}


def read(workspace, study_id, run_id, **options):
    """Read one exact saved study case without changing its original state."""
    from .parameter_views import DEFAULT_VIEWS, _study_active, _bind_case
    study_id, run_id = identifier(study_id), identifier(run_id)
    study, matches, context = DEFAULT_VIEWS.case_context(workspace, study_id, run_id)
    cases = [{name: case.get(name) for name in ("id", "label", "run_id", "profile_id", "overrides")}
             for case in matches]
    value = read_run(workspace, run_id, **options)
    # The selected native receipt must still match the original case after reading.
    for case in matches:
        _bind_case(study, case, {"selection": value["native"]["selection"]})
    active = _study_active(workspace.root / "experiments" / study_id)
    visible = "interrupted" if study["state"] == "running" and not active else study["state"]
    return {**value, "schema": SCHEMA, "study_id": study_id,
            "title": study["selection"]["title"], "study_state": visible,
            "study_recorded_state": study["state"], "study_active": active,
            "case_bindings": cases, "context": context,
            "continuation": {"action": "parameter-study.run", "payload": {"experiment_id": study_id},
                             "scope": "The original saved study and its remaining cases",
                             "native_run_argv": value["native"]["continue_argv"]}}

"""Compact saved parameter-study pages over the original native records.

Full scientific inspection, execution, calibration and exports remain with the
maintained parameter-study engine. These projections only serve navigation.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import fcntl
import json
import os

from .common import digest, identifier
from .model_selection import run_models, selected, validate_completed_run
from .native_execution import _active
from .native_versions import model_versions, version_label
from .parameter_studies import _baseline_versions, _bind_state
from .record_catalog import ProjectedFileCache


def _number(value, name, default, maximum=None):
    if value in (None, ""):
        return default
    if isinstance(value, bool):
        raise ValueError(name + " must be a nonnegative integer")
    try:
        result = int(value)
    except (TypeError, ValueError, OverflowError):
        raise ValueError(name + " must be a nonnegative integer") from None
    if result < 0 or str(result) != str(value) or (maximum is not None and result > maximum):
        raise ValueError(name + " must be a nonnegative integer"
                         + (" up to " + str(maximum) if maximum is not None else ""))
    return result


def _study_active(directory):
    try:
        fd = os.open(directory / ".experiment.lock", os.O_RDONLY | os.O_NOFOLLOW)
    except FileNotFoundError:
        return False
    try:
        try:
            fcntl.flock(fd, fcntl.LOCK_EX | fcntl.LOCK_NB)
            return False
        except BlockingIOError:
            return True
    finally:
        os.close(fd)


def _bind_case(state, case, native):
    active = selected(state["baseline_selection"])
    selection = native["selection"]
    if (selection["profile_id"] != case["profile_id"]
            or run_models(native) != active
            or any(selection[name] != state["baseline_selection"][name]
                   for name in ("grid_id", "scenario_id"))):
        raise ValueError("An experiment case changed its retained model selection")
    if "run_selection" in case:
        if not isinstance(case["run_selection"], dict) or selection != case["run_selection"]:
            raise ValueError("An experiment case changed its original saved run selection")
    elif selection.get("invest_version") != state["baseline_selection"].get("invest_version"):
        raise ValueError("A legacy experiment case changed its retained requested version")
    if case["id"] == "baseline" and (
            case["run_id"] != state["selection"]["baseline_run_id"]
            or selection != state["baseline_selection"]):
        raise ValueError("The experiment baseline differs from its original saved run")


class ParameterViews:
    """Cache isolated original projections and observe live locks on each read."""

    def __init__(self):
        self.records = ProjectedFileCache(max_bytes=32 * 1024 * 1024)
        self.native = ProjectedFileCache(max_bytes=16 * 1024 * 1024)

    def record(self, workspace, key):
        key = identifier(key)

        def spec_projection(value):
            if digest(value) != key:
                raise ValueError("Retained parameter-study specification changed")
            return {**value, "id": key}

        spec = self.records.read(workspace.root / "experiment-specs" / (key + ".json"),
                                 spec_projection)

        def project(value):
            state = _bind_state(workspace, key, spec, value)
            if not isinstance(state.get("cases"), list):
                raise ValueError("The saved parameter-study case inventory changed")
            return state

        state = self.records.read(workspace.root / "experiments" / key / "experiment.json", project)
        # Check a changed specification and receiving project even on cache hits.
        return _bind_state(workspace, key, spec, state)

    def _native(self, workspace, key):
        key = identifier(key)

        def project(value):
            # Same original selection and completed-stage validation as inspect_run.
            if value.get("id") != key or digest(value["selection"]) != key:
                raise ValueError("Original run identity or selection changed")
            validate_completed_run(value)
            versions = model_versions(value) if value["state"] == "complete" else None
            return {"selection": value["selection"], "state": value["state"],
                    "error": value.get("error"), "source_sha256": digest(value),
                    "baseline_versions": _baseline_versions(value),
                    "native_versions": versions,
                    "native_version_labels": ({model: version_label(info)
                        for model, info in versions.items()} if versions is not None else None)}

        return self.native.read(workspace.root / "runs" / key / "run.json", project)

    def case_context(self, workspace, key, run_id):
        """Return the original worker binding without reading unrelated native runs."""
        key, run_id = identifier(key), identifier(run_id)
        state = self.record(workspace, key)
        matches = [case for case in state["cases"] if case["run_id"] == run_id]
        if not matches:
            raise ValueError("The native worker run is outside this saved parameter study")
        native = self._native(workspace, run_id)
        for case in matches:
            _bind_case(state, case, native)
        bindings = [{name: case[name] for name in (
            "id", "run_id", "profile_id", "run_selection", "overrides", "axis_values")
            if name in case} for case in matches]
        context = {"schema": "upstate.parameter-study-worker-context/v1", "study_id": key,
                   "run_id": run_id, "selection_sha256": digest(state["selection"]),
                   "bindings_sha256": digest(bindings)}
        return state, matches, context

    def read(self, workspace, key, *, offset=0, limit=50, case_filter="all", query="",
             run_id=None):
        key = identifier(key)
        offset = _number(offset, "Case offset", 0)
        limit = _number(limit, "Case page size", 50, 500)
        if case_filter not in ("all", "unfinished", "complete", "failed", "interrupted"):
            raise ValueError("Choose all, unfinished, complete, failed or interrupted cases")
        if not isinstance(query, str):
            raise ValueError("Search an original case, parameter or run ID")
        wanted = query.strip().casefold()
        run_id = identifier(run_id) if run_id is not None else None
        state = self.record(workspace, key)
        originals, rows = {}, []
        for case in state["cases"]:
            native_id = identifier(case["run_id"])
            if native_id not in originals:
                native = self._native(workspace, native_id)
                originals[native_id] = (native, _active(workspace.root / "runs" / native_id))
            native, native_active = originals[native_id]
            _bind_case(state, case, native)
            row = dict(case)
            visible = ("interrupted" if native["state"] == "running" and not native_active
                       else native["state"])
            row.update(state=visible, recorded_state=native["state"], active=native_active)
            if native.get("error"):
                row["error"] = native["error"]
            else:
                row.pop("error", None)
            if native["state"] == "complete":
                row["native_versions"] = native["native_versions"]
                row["native_version_labels"] = native["native_version_labels"]
            else:
                row.pop("native_versions", None)
                row.pop("native_version_labels", None)
            if case["id"] == "baseline":
                state.update(native["baseline_versions"])
            rows.append(row)
        if run_id is not None and not any(row["run_id"] == run_id for row in rows):
            raise ValueError("The native run is outside this original saved study")
        completed = sum(row["state"] == "complete" for row in rows)
        failed = sum(row["state"] == "failed" for row in rows)
        running = sum(row["state"] == "running" for row in rows)
        interrupted = sum(row["state"] == "interrupted" for row in rows)
        active = _study_active(workspace.root / "experiments" / key)
        native_active = any(row["active"] for row in rows)
        recorded = state["state"]
        visible = "interrupted" if recorded == "running" and not active else recorded
        if visible == "complete" and completed != len(rows):
            visible = "partial"
        filtered = [row for row in rows if
            (run_id is None or row["run_id"] == run_id)
            and (case_filter == "all" or
                 (row["state"] != "complete" if case_filter == "unfinished"
                  else row["state"] == case_filter))
            and (not wanted or wanted in " ".join([
                str(row.get("id", "")), str(row.get("label", "")),
                str(row.get("run_id", "")), str(row.get("profile_id", "")),
                json.dumps(row.get("overrides", {}), ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True),
            ]).casefold())]
        if limit:
            offset = min(offset, max(0, ((len(filtered) - 1) // limit) * limit))
        else:
            offset = 0
        page = filtered if run_id is not None else filtered[offset:offset + limit]
        result = {name: value for name, value in state.items() if name != "cases"}
        result.update(state=visible, recorded_state=recorded, active=active,
                      native_active=native_active, cases=page, case_count=len(rows),
                      cases_complete=len(page) == len(rows),
                      progress={"total": len(rows), "completed": completed, "failed": failed,
                                "running": running, "interrupted": interrupted,
                                "pending": len(rows) - completed - failed - running - interrupted},
                      active_case=next((row for row in rows
                                        if row["id"] == state.get("active_case_id")), None),
                      page={"offset": offset, "limit": limit, "total": len(filtered),
                            "study_total": len(rows), "filter": case_filter, "query": query},
                      observation_id=digest({"study_id": key, "updated_at": state.get("updated_at"),
                          "recorded_state": recorded, "active": active,
                          "rows": [(row["id"], row["state"], row["active"],
                                    originals[row["run_id"]][0]["source_sha256"]) for row in rows]}))
        return result


DEFAULT_VIEWS = ParameterViews()

"""Select a retained Parameter result edition for the shared SourceReports composer.

The original study owns every value, comparison and map. This adapter freezes its
complete exported inputs, then presents the explicitly selected original rows.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

from copy import deepcopy
import csv
import io
from pathlib import Path

from .common import (atomic_bytes, atomic_json, describe_file, digest, file_digest,
                     held, identifier, now, read_json, relative_file, verify_file)
from . import parameter_studies, ensemble_scientific_source as shared
from .parameter_result_query import DEFAULT_RESULTS
from .parameter_exports import member_descriptors, MEMBER_SCHEMA
from .parameter_views import DEFAULT_VIEWS
from . import parameter_scientific_figures as figures
from . import ensemble_study_scope as source_scope
from . import parameter_support_reconciliation as reconciliation

DIRECTORY = "parameter-report-sources"
SCHEMA = "upstate.parameter-report-source/v1"
SOURCE_ID = "saved-parameter-study"
EDITION = 3


def _choices(value, available, label):
    if value is None:
        return list(available)
    if (not isinstance(value, list) or not value or
            any(not isinstance(item, str) or item not in available for item in value) or
            len(set(value)) != len(value)):
        raise ValueError("Choose original " + label + " from this saved result")
    chosen = set(value)
    return [item for item in available if item in chosen]


def _metadata(workspace, key):
    """Open one small indexed page; retain the original matrix as its authority."""
    return DEFAULT_RESULTS.read(workspace, key, limit=1, range_limit=1)


def catalog(workspace, experiment_id):
    key = identifier(experiment_id)
    result = _metadata(workspace, key)
    state = DEFAULT_VIEWS.record(workspace, key)
    available_runs = set(result.get("native_run_selections", {}))
    if not available_runs:
        raise ValueError("Refresh the saved native summary before preparing its scientific source")
    cases = [{name: deepcopy(case[name]) for name in (
        "id", "label", "run_id", "profile_id", "overrides", "axis_values") if name in case}
        for case in state["cases"] if case["run_id"] in available_runs]
    if not cases:
        raise ValueError("The saved result has no retained completed parameter case")
    original_cases = {row["id"]: row for row in state["cases"]}
    for case in cases:
        frozen = original_cases[case["id"]]
        selected = result["native_run_selections"][case["run_id"]]
        if (selected["profile_id"] != case["profile_id"] or
                any(selected[name] != state["baseline_selection"][name]
                    for name in ("grid_id", "scenario_id")) or
                ("run_selection" in frozen and frozen["run_selection"] != selected)):
            raise ValueError("The saved summary differs from its original case selection")
    return {
        "schema": "upstate.parameter-report-catalog/v1", "experiment_id": key,
        "workspace_id": workspace.project["id"], "title": result["title"],
        "purpose": result["purpose"], "artifact_sha256": result["artifact_sha256"],
        "artifact_bytes": result["artifact_bytes"], "cases": cases,
        "areas": deepcopy(result["areas"]), "pollutants": list(result["pollutants"]),
        "models": list(result["models"]), "completed_cases": result["completed_cases"],
        "total_cases": result["total_cases"], "selection": deepcopy(state["selection"]),
        "baseline_selection": deepcopy(state["baseline_selection"]),
        "comparison_id": state.get("comparison_id"),
        "latest": latest(workspace, key),
    }


def preview(workspace, value):
    if not isinstance(value, dict):
        raise ValueError("Choose a saved Parameter result and its report contents")
    packet = catalog(workspace, identifier(value.get("experiment_id")))
    if value.get("expected_artifact_sha256") != packet["artifact_sha256"]:
        raise ValueError("The saved result edition changed. Review its report selection again")
    case_ids = _choices(value.get("case_ids"), [row["id"] for row in packet["cases"]], "parameter cases")
    area_ids = _choices(value.get("area_ids"), [row["id"] for row in packet["areas"]], "reporting areas")
    pollutants = _choices(value.get("pollutants"), packet["pollutants"], "pollutants")
    title = str(value.get("title") or ("Parameter study: " + packet["title"])).strip()
    if not title:
        raise ValueError("Name the scientific report source")
    selection = {
        "edition": EDITION, "experiment_id": packet["experiment_id"],
        "workspace_id": workspace.project["id"], "title": title,
        "expected_artifact_sha256": packet["artifact_sha256"],
        "case_ids": case_ids, "area_ids": area_ids, "pollutants": pollutants,
    }
    return {"selection": selection, "cases": [row for row in packet["cases"] if row["id"] in case_ids],
            "areas": [row for row in packet["areas"] if row["id"] in area_ids],
            "models": packet["models"], "pollutants": pollutants,
            "selected_rows": len(case_ids) * len(area_ids) * len(pollutants),
            "includes_all_completed_cases": len(case_ids) == len(packet["cases"]),
            "completed_cases": packet["completed_cases"], "total_cases": packet["total_cases"],
            "comparison_id": packet["comparison_id"],
            "reference": {
                "run_id": packet["selection"].get("baseline_run_id"),
                "profile_id": packet["baseline_selection"].get("profile_id"),
                "scenario_id": packet["baseline_selection"].get("scenario_id"),
                "grid_id": packet["baseline_selection"].get("grid_id"),
                "run_selection": deepcopy(packet["baseline_selection"]),
            },
            "comparison_basis": "Original case minus baseline on paired valid cells, separately for each reporting area.",
            "range_basis": ("Original saved completed-case ranges appear only when every completed case is selected. "
                            "Selecting fewer cases does not recalculate or relabel those ranges.")}


def _table(columns, rows):
    return {"kind": "table", "columns": columns,
            "rows": [[shared._text(value) if value is not None else "Undefined"
                      for value in row] for row in rows]}


def _selected_rows(workspace, key, selection):
    """Page original byte spans; no native calculation or full-matrix parse."""
    rows, ranges = [], []
    chosen = set(selection["case_ids"])
    for area in selection["area_ids"]:
        for pollutant in selection["pollutants"]:
            offset = range_offset = 0
            while True:
                packet = DEFAULT_RESULTS.read(
                    workspace, key, area_id=area, pollutant=pollutant,
                    offset=offset, limit=500, range_offset=range_offset, range_limit=500,
                    expected_artifact_sha256=selection["expected_artifact_sha256"])
                if packet["edition_changed"]:
                    raise ValueError("The original Parameter result changed during source preparation")
                rows.extend(row for row in packet["rows"] if row["case_id"] in chosen)
                if offset == 0:
                    ranges.extend(packet["ranges"])
                offset += len(packet["rows"])
                if offset >= packet["filtered_rows"]:
                    break
                if not packet["rows"]:
                    raise ValueError("The original Parameter result page did not advance")
    identities = [(row["case_id"], row["area_id"], row["pollutant"]) for row in rows]
    expected = {(case, area, pollutant) for case in chosen for area in selection["area_ids"]
                for pollutant in selection["pollutants"]}
    if len(identities) != len(set(identities)) or set(identities) != expected:
        raise ValueError("The original result does not contain exactly the selected case/area/pollutant matrix")
    return rows, ranges


def _retain_source(workspace, directory, collection_id, source_id, records, bindings):
    identity = (identifier(collection_id), source_id)
    if identity in bindings:
        return
    source, entry = workspace.source_file(*identity)
    collection = workspace._get("sources", identity[0])
    prefix = directory / "original-sources" / identity[0] / digest(source_id)
    atomic_json(prefix / "entry.json", entry, immutable=True)
    shared._copy(workspace, collection["original_manifest"], prefix / "original-manifest.json")
    for item in [entry["body"], *entry.get("companions", [])]:
        shared._copy(workspace, item, prefix / "members" / shared._member(
            item.get("view_path", item["filename"])))
    bindings[identity] = {"source_collection_id": identity[0], "source_id": identity[1],
                          "entry": deepcopy(entry)}
    records.append({"id": "original-%04d" % len(records), "source_collection_id": identity[0],
                    "source_id": source_id, "title": entry.get("title", source_id),
                    "uri": entry.get("uri", ""), "vintage": entry.get("vintage", ""),
                    "body_sha256": entry["body"]["sha256"]})


def _source_scope(workspace, directory, grid, profiles, areas, scenario_id, records, bindings):
    """Present the original input declarations without copying large raster bodies."""
    roles = {}
    for profile in profiles.values():
        ref = (identifier(profile["source_collection_id"]), profile["biophysical_source_id"])
        roles.setdefault(ref, set()).add("biophysical table")
    for area in areas:
        choice = area.get("source", {}).get("selection")
        if choice:
            ref = (identifier(choice["source_collection_id"]), choice["source_id"])
            roles.setdefault(ref, set()).add("selected reporting area: " + area["id"])
    scenario = workspace._get("scenarios", identifier(scenario_id))
    atomic_json(directory / "original" / "scenarios" / (scenario["id"] + ".json"),
                scenario, immutable=True)
    for patch in scenario.get("patches", []):
        ref = (identifier(scenario["source_collection_id"]), patch["mask_source_id"])
        roles.setdefault(ref, set()).add("scenario mask: " + scenario["id"])
    spec = grid["spec"]
    collection_id = identifier(spec["source_collection_id"])
    for role, source_id in spec["input_sources"].items():
        roles.setdefault((collection_id, source_id), set()).add(role)
    for role in ("model_domain", "reporting_area"):
        choice = spec.get(role)
        if isinstance(choice, dict) and choice.get("source_id"):
            roles.setdefault((collection_id, choice["source_id"]), set()).add(role)
    # Keep the shared scope section's original-grid link independently usable.
    atomic_json(directory / "original" / "grid.json", grid, immutable=True)
    collections = {}
    for ref in sorted(roles):
        collection_id, source_id = ref
        if collection_id not in collections:
            collection = workspace._get("sources", collection_id)
            collections[collection_id] = collection
            atomic_json(directory / "original" / "source-collections" /
                        (collection_id + ".json"), collection, immutable=True)
            shared._copy(workspace, collection["original_manifest"],
                         directory / "original" / "source-manifests" /
                         (collection_id + ".json"))
        matches = [entry for entry in collections[collection_id]["entries"]
                   if entry["id"] == source_id]
        if len(matches) != 1:
            raise ValueError("An original Parameter input is absent from its retained source edition")
        entry = matches[0]
        if ref in bindings:
            if bindings[ref]["entry"] != entry:
                raise ValueError("The original Parameter source changed while its report was retained")
            bindings[ref]["roles"] = sorted(roles[ref])
            bindings[ref]["original_bytes_in_report_package"] = True
        else:
            bindings[ref] = {
                "source_collection_id": collection_id, "source_id": source_id,
                "roles": sorted(roles[ref]), "entry": deepcopy(entry),
                "original_bytes_in_report_package": False,
            }
            records.append({
                "id": "original-%04d" % len(records), "source_collection_id": collection_id,
                "source_id": source_id, "title": entry.get("title", source_id),
                "uri": entry.get("uri", ""), "vintage": entry.get("vintage", ""),
                "body_sha256": entry["body"]["sha256"],
            })
    scope, extras, reference_records = source_scope.capture(
        workspace, directory, grid, profiles, list(bindings.values()), collections)
    for binding in extras:
        bindings[(binding["source_collection_id"], binding["source_id"])] = binding
    records.extend(reference_records)
    return scope


def _freeze(workspace, key, directory, selected, state):
    original = workspace.root / "experiments" / key
    artifact = state["artifacts"]["results"]
    if artifact["sha256"] != selected["selection"]["expected_artifact_sha256"]:
        raise ValueError("The selected original summary changed before freezing its files")
    member = state["artifacts"].get("export_manifest")
    if not member:
        raise ValueError("Refresh completed results to retain the complete native export manifest")
    manifest = read_json(verify_file(original, member))
    if (manifest.get("schema") != MEMBER_SCHEMA or manifest.get("study_id") != key or
            manifest.get("workspace_id") != workspace.project["id"] or
            manifest.get("selection_sha256") != digest(state["selection"])):
        raise ValueError("The original export manifest belongs to another saved study")
    files = member_descriptors(original, manifest["files"])
    if files.get(artifact["path"]) != artifact:
        # Descriptors may carry presentation metadata; body identity is exact.
        body = files.get(artifact["path"], {})
        if any(body.get(name) != artifact.get(name) for name in ("path", "bytes", "sha256")):
            raise ValueError("The original export manifest does not bind the selected result")
    for item in [*files.values(), member]:
        source = relative_file(original, item["path"])
        shared._copy(workspace, {**item, "path": source.relative_to(workspace.root).as_posix()},
                     directory / "original-study" / shared._member(item["path"]))
    checkpoint = directory / "original-study" / "checkpoint.json"
    if checkpoint.exists():
        prior = read_json(checkpoint)
        if (prior.get("selection") != state["selection"] or
                prior.get("artifacts", {}).get("results") != state["artifacts"]["results"]):
            raise ValueError("The frozen original checkpoint selects another scientific result")
    else:
        atomic_json(checkpoint, state, immutable=True)
    atomic_json(directory / "selection.json", selected, immutable=True)
    rows, ranges = _selected_rows(workspace, key, selected["selection"])
    if not selected["includes_all_completed_cases"]:
        ranges = []
    atomic_json(directory / "selected-results.json", {
        "schema": "upstate.selected-parameter-results/v1",
        "selection": selected["selection"], "rows": rows, "ranges": ranges,
        "range_basis": selected["range_basis"]}, immutable=True)
    fields = ("case_id", "case", "run_id", "profile_id", "area_id", "area", "pollutant", "units",
              "baseline_mass", "case_mass", "change", "percent_change", "baseline_full_mass",
              "case_full_mass", "baseline_valid_cells", "case_valid_cells", "paired_valid_cells",
              "paired_area_ha", "support_changed", "parameter", "baseline_parameter",
              "case_parameter", "response_per_parameter_unit", "elasticity", "pixel_area_ha",
              "baseline_valid_area_ha", "case_valid_area_ha")
    buffer = io.StringIO(newline="")
    writer = csv.DictWriter(buffer, fieldnames=fields, extrasaction="ignore")
    writer.writeheader()
    for row in rows:
        writer.writerow({name: ("'" + value if isinstance(value, str) and
                               value.startswith(("=", "+", "-", "@", "\t", "\r")) else value)
                         for name, value in row.items()})
    atomic_bytes(directory / "selected-results.csv", buffer.getvalue().encode("utf-8"), immutable=True)
    records, bindings, profiles = [], {}, {}
    for profile_id in dict.fromkeys([state["baseline_selection"]["profile_id"],
                                    *(row["profile_id"] for row in selected["cases"])]):
        profile = workspace._get("profiles", identifier(profile_id))
        profiles[profile_id] = profile
        atomic_json(directory / "profiles" / (profile_id + ".json"), profile, immutable=True)
        _retain_source(workspace, directory, profile["source_collection_id"],
                       profile["biophysical_source_id"], records, bindings)
    for area in selected["areas"]:
        original_selection = area.get("source", {}).get("selection")
        if original_selection:
            _retain_source(workspace, directory, original_selection["source_collection_id"],
                           original_selection["source_id"], records, bindings)
    grid = workspace.get_grid(state["baseline_selection"]["grid_id"])
    grid_root = workspace.root / "grids" / grid["id"]
    atomic_json(directory / "grid.json", grid, immutable=True)
    for name in ("reporting_area", "model_domain"):
        item = grid["files"].get(name)
        if item:
            shared._copy(workspace, {**item, "path": relative_file(
                grid_root, item["path"]).relative_to(workspace.root).as_posix()},
                         directory / "geography" / shared._member(item["path"]))
    scope = _source_scope(workspace, directory, grid, profiles, selected["areas"],
                          state["baseline_selection"]["scenario_id"], records, bindings)
    atomic_json(directory / "original-source-editions.json", records, immutable=True)
    atomic_json(directory / "native-input-inventory.json", {
        "workspace_id": workspace.project["id"], "experiment_id": key,
        "baseline_selection": state["baseline_selection"], "grid": grid,
        "source_bindings": list(bindings.values()),
        "scope": "Complete original study exports, native arguments and aggregation context are retained. "
                 "Original source classifications, fixed scenario and explicitly referenced assumption or recipe "
                 "documents are retained with the selected profile and source editions. The full Workspace "
                 "archive retains the large original/aligned model-input and output rasters and scenario masks."
    }, immutable=True)
    return rows, ranges, records, scope


def _sections(selected, rows, ranges):
    selection = selected["selection"]
    positions = {key: index + 1 for index, key in enumerate(selection["case_ids"])}
    reference = selected.get("reference", {})

    def percent_value(row):
        if row["percent_change"] is not None:
            return row["percent_change"]
        if not row["paired_valid_cells"]:
            return "Undefined: no paired valid cells"
        if row["baseline_mass"] == 0:
            return "Undefined: zero paired baseline"
        return "Undefined in original result"

    def mask_agreement(row):
        if not row["paired_valid_cells"]:
            return "No paired valid cells"
        return "No" if row["support_changed"] else "Yes"

    def response_value(row, name):
        if "parameter" not in row:
            return "Not applicable / not reported"
        if name == "elasticity" and row.get(name) is None:
            if row["baseline_mass"] in (None, 0):
                return "Undefined: zero or unavailable baseline mass"
            if row.get("baseline_parameter") == 0:
                return "Undefined: zero baseline parameter"
            return "Undefined in original result"
        return row.get(name)

    sections = [
        ["Saved Parameter result selection", [
            selected["comparison_basis"],
            "Every displayed physical value comes from the selected saved result edition. "
            "Changing report choices runs no model and changes no scientific value.",
            _table(["Original selection", "Retained value"], [
                ["Study", selection["experiment_id"]],
                ["Result SHA256", selection["expected_artifact_sha256"]],
                ["Completed original cases", selected["completed_cases"]],
                ["Cases in the original design", selected["total_cases"]],
                ["Completed cases selected for this report", len(selection["case_ids"])],
                ["Selected reporting areas", len(selection["area_ids"])],
                ["Selected pollutants", ", ".join(selection["pollutants"])],
            ]),
            "Completed-case counts include the native study's reference case when it is retained. "
            "A partial study preserves its completed results and the original design count; "
            "unfinished cases do not become zero responses. A report may explicitly select fewer "
            "completed cases than the study contains.",
        ]],
        ["Original fixed baseline and case key", [
            "Every parameter case is compared with this original baseline, including when the "
            "baseline case itself was excluded from the report selection. Land cover and grid "
            "remain the original study selections.",
            _table(["Reference selection", "Original identity"], [
                ["Baseline native run", reference.get("run_id") or "Unspecified in the original selection"],
                ["Baseline profile", reference.get("profile_id") or "Unspecified in the original selection"],
                ["Land-cover scenario", reference.get("scenario_id") or "Unspecified in the original selection"],
                ["Prepared grid", reference.get("grid_id") or "Unspecified in the original selection"],
            ]),
            "Case positions below match the existing figure ticks and coordinate exports for this "
            "retained report selection. They keep the same case across reporting areas and pollutants. "
            "They are display keys, not parameter values or persistent native case IDs.",
            _table(["Position", "Original case", "Native case ID"], [
                [positions[row["id"]], row["label"], row["id"]] for row in selected["cases"]
            ]),
            _table(["Position", "Original profile", "Native run", "Parameter assignments"], [
                [positions[row["id"]], row["profile_id"], row["run_id"], row.get("overrides", {})]
                for row in selected["cases"]
            ]),
        ]],
        ["Reporting geography", [
            "Each selected polygon is intersected with the original model reporting mask at pixel centres. "
            "Paired masses use cells valid in both the baseline and the case within that area. "
            "Own-valid full totals use each run's own valid cells inside the same area and reporting mask.",
            _table(["Area", "Area ID", "Original area (ha)", "Reporting intersection (ha)"], [
                [row["name"], row["id"], row.get("source_area_ha"), row.get("reporting_intersection_ha")]
                for row in selected["areas"]
            ]),
            _table(["Area", "Original source selection"], [
                [row["name"], row.get("source", {})] for row in selected["areas"]
            ]),
            "These original areas and paired hectare values retain the native grid's own area calculation. "
            "They are not derived from a fixed nominal pixel size in this report.",
        ]],
    ]
    for area in selected["areas"]:
        for pollutant in selection["pollutants"]:
            chosen = [row for row in rows if row["area_id"] == area["id"] and row["pollutant"] == pollutant]
            for offset in range(0, len(chosen), 80):
                page = chosen[offset:offset + 80]
                title = (area["name"] + " / " + pollutant.replace("_export", "") +
                         " / selected cases " + str(offset + 1) + "–" + str(offset + len(page)))
                sections.append([title + " — paired annual mass", [
                    "Change is the original selected case minus baseline on cells valid in both runs. "
                    "Negative change means lower modeled export. The position identifies the original "
                    "case in the fixed-baseline case key and figures.",
                    _table(["Position", "Units", "Baseline paired mass", "Case paired mass",
                            "Signed change", "Change (%)"], [
                        [positions[row["case_id"]], row["units"], row["baseline_mass"], row["case_mass"],
                         row["change"], percent_value(row)] for row in page
                    ]),
                    "No paired valid cells leaves both paired masses, change and percent undefined. "
                    "With paired cells present, a zero baseline mass leaves percent undefined even "
                    "when the stored mass change is defined. Original missing values do not become zero.",
                ]])
                sections.append([title + " — original geographic support", [
                    _table(["Position", "Baseline valid", "Case valid", "Paired valid",
                            "Paired area (ha)", "Pair masks identical"], [
                        [positions[row["case_id"]], row["baseline_valid_cells"], row["case_valid_cells"],
                         row["paired_valid_cells"], row["paired_area_ha"], mask_agreement(row)]
                        for row in page
                    ]),
                    "Pair masks identical means the original support_changed field is false with "
                    "paired cells present. Both runs can still share missing cells. Counts cover this "
                    "selected area inside the reporting mask; they do not establish whole-catchment "
                    "coverage. Changed-support pairs retain their own original intersection.",
                    _table(["Position", "Units", "Baseline own-valid full mass", "Case own-valid full mass"], [
                        [positions[row["case_id"]], row["units"], row["baseline_full_mass"],
                         row["case_full_mass"]] for row in page

                    "The two own-valid full totals can cover different cells. Their subtraction "
                    "does not replace the original paired change. A run without valid cells has an "
                    "undefined own-valid mass; a valid stored zero remains zero.",

                if any("parameter" in row for row in page):
                    sections.append([title + " — finite parameter response", [
                        _table(["Position", "Varied parameter", "Baseline parameter", "Case parameter"], [
                            [positions[row["case_id"]], row.get("parameter", "Not applicable / not reported"),
                             response_value(row, "baseline_parameter"), response_value(row, "case_parameter")]
                            for row in page
                        ]),
                        _table(["Position", "Mass units", "Response per parameter unit", "Elasticity"], [
                            [positions[row["case_id"]], row["units"],
                             response_value(row, "response_per_parameter_unit"),
                             response_value(row, "elasticity")] for row in page
                        ]),
                        "The native producer reports a response only for a single numeric override, "
                        "a nonzero tested parameter step and a defined paired change. It is the saved "
                        "finite change per original parameter unit. Elasticity also needs nonzero "
                        "baseline mass and baseline parameter. Routing choices and multi-parameter "
                        "cases have no single-parameter response. These values describe the tested "
                        "step; they are not a fitted derivative, calibration or probability estimate.",
                    ]])
    if ranges:
        sections.append(["Original ranges over eligible completed cases", [
            selected["range_basis"],
            "The retained ranges describe completed original cases with paired data and unchanged "
            "baseline support in each area, including the native reference case. They do not describe "
            "unfinished cases or a probability distribution. Their values are copied from the saved "
            "producer; this report does not recalculate them.",
            _table(["Area", "Pollutant", "Units", "Eligible completed cases", "Minimum case mass",
                    "Maximum case mass"], [
                [row[name] for name in ("area", "pollutant", "units", "cases", "minimum_mass",
                                       "maximum_mass")] for row in ranges
            ]),
            _table(["Area / pollutant", "Minimum case ID", "Maximum case ID",
                    "Changed-support cases with paired data"], [
                [row["area"] + " / " + row["pollutant"], row["minimum_case_id"],
                 row["maximum_case_id"], row["support_changed_cases"]] for row in ranges
            ]),
            "Changed-support cases with paired data are excluded from these ranges and remain "
            "visible in the original paired/support tables. Cases without paired data are separate "
            "undefined rows and are not included in that changed-support count.",
        ]])
    else:
        sections.append(["Original completed-case range selection", [
            selected["range_basis"],
            "No original range rows are included in this source selection. Selecting only some "
            "completed cases does not create a new range. The original selected pair rows remain "
            "available with their own geographic support.",
        ]])
    sections.extend(reconciliation.sections(selected, rows))
    sections.append(["Original files and spatial interpretation", [
        "The complete original report retains every case, area, pollutant, executed version and requested difference map. "
        "GIS rasters describe the original comparison extent; selecting a reporting polygon here does not clip or modify a raster. "
        "Undefined quantities remain undefined.",
        {"kind": "links", "items": [
            {"title": "Selected exact numeric rows (JSON)", "path": "selected-results.json"},
            {"title": "Selected rows (CSV)", "path": "selected-results.csv"},
            {"title": "Original complete scientific report", "path": "original-study/report.html"},
            {"title": "Complete original results", "path": "original-study/results.json"},
            {"title": "Original exported member identities", "path": "original-study/export-manifest.json"},
            {"title": "Native input inventory and source bindings", "path": "native-input-inventory.json"}]},
    ]])
    return sections


def _recipe(directory, selected, rows, ranges, scope):
    reconciliation.write(directory, selected, rows)
    graphics = figures.write(directory, selected, rows)
    source_sections = source_scope.sections(scope)
    scenario_id = identifier(selected["reference"]["scenario_id"])
    scenario_path = "original/scenarios/" + scenario_id + ".json"
    scenario = read_json(directory / scenario_path)
    scenario_section = ["Original fixed land-cover scenario", [
        "Every selected parameter case retains this exact original land-cover scenario. "
        "Its source declarations and change masks remain distinct from the tested parameter assignments.",
        _table(["Original scenario property", "Retained value"], [
            ["Title", scenario.get("title")],
            ["Scenario ID", scenario["id"]],
            ["Kind", scenario.get("kind")],
            ["Reason", scenario.get("reason")],
        ]),
        {"kind": "links", "items": [
            {"title": "Complete original fixed scenario and patch selections", "path": scenario_path}]},
    ]]
    sections = [source_sections[0], scenario_section, *_sections(selected, rows, ranges),
                *source_sections[1:]]

        "Figures preserve each original pair separately. Undefined quantities have no plotted point. "
        "Full geographic support and original case/profile/run keys accompany each figure.",
        _table(["Selected rows", "Figures", "Plotted values", "Undefined values"], [[

    members = [describe_file(directory, path) for path in sorted(directory.rglob("*"))
               if path.is_file() and path not in {directory / "sources.json", directory / "scientific-report.json"}]
    recipe = {"schema": shared.RECIPE_SCHEMA, "title": selected["selection"]["title"],
