    atomic_json(directory / "scientific-report.json", recipe, immutable=True)
    atomic_json(directory / "sources.json", {
        "schema": "upstate.sources/v1", "title": recipe["title"], "entries": [{
            "id": SOURCE_ID, "kind": "document", "role": shared.ROLE, "title": recipe["title"],
            "path": "scientific-report.json", "sha256": file_digest(directory / "scientific-report.json"),
            "uri": "urn:upstate:parameter-study:" + selected["selection"]["experiment_id"] +
                   ":" + selected["selection"]["expected_artifact_sha256"],
            "vintage": "Retained Parameter result " + selected["selection"]["expected_artifact_sha256"],
            "units": "Original annual mass and coverage, separated by pollutant and reporting area",
            "metadata": {"report_schema": shared.RECIPE_SCHEMA, "source_basis": "saved_parameter_study",
                         "experiment_id": selected["selection"]["experiment_id"]},
            "companions": [{"path": row["path"], "sha256": row["sha256"]} for row in members],
        }]}, immutable=True)


def get(workspace, source_id):
    key = identifier(source_id)
    directory = workspace.root / DIRECTORY / key
    operation = read_json(directory / "operation.json")
    if (operation.get("schema") != SCHEMA or operation.get("id") != key or
            operation.get("workspace_id") != workspace.project["id"] or
            digest(operation["identity"]) != key or
            operation.get("selection") != operation["identity"].get("selection") or
            operation.get("experiment_id") != operation["selection"].get("experiment_id")):
        raise ValueError("The Parameter scientific source belongs to another original selection")
    state = DEFAULT_RESULTS.checkpoint(workspace, identifier(operation["experiment_id"]))
    current = state.get("artifacts", {}).get("results", {}).get("sha256")
    return {**operation, "source_state": (
        "current" if current == operation["selection"]["expected_artifact_sha256"] else "earlier-result")}


def summary(workspace, experiment_id, artifact_sha256=None):
    """Read the compact pointer without parsing the selected case/source inventory."""
    key = identifier(experiment_id)
    pointer = workspace.root / "experiments" / key / "latest-scientific-source.json"
    if not pointer.is_file():
        return None
    value = read_json(pointer)
    if value.get("experiment_id") != key:
        raise ValueError("The scientific source pointer belongs to another study")
    return {"id": identifier(value["source_operation_id"]), "experiment_id": key,
            "title": value.get("title"), "state": value.get("state"),
            "source_state": "current" if value.get("artifact_sha256") == artifact_sha256 else "earlier-result"}


def latest(workspace, experiment_id):
    key = identifier(experiment_id)
    pointer = workspace.root / "experiments" / key / "latest-scientific-source.json"
    if not pointer.is_file():
        return None
    value = read_json(pointer)
    result = get(workspace, identifier(value["source_operation_id"]))
    if result["experiment_id"] != key:
        raise ValueError("The scientific source pointer belongs to another study")
    return result


def prepare(workspace, value, *, render=True):
    if type(render) is not bool:
        raise ValueError("Choose whether to render the shared scientific report")
    selected = preview(workspace, value)
    key = selected["selection"]["experiment_id"]
    state = parameter_studies._read(workspace, key)
    identity = {"schema": SCHEMA, "selection": selected["selection"],
                "export_manifest": state.get("artifacts", {}).get("export_manifest"),
                "producer_sha256": file_digest(Path(__file__)),
                "figure_helper_sha256": file_digest(Path(figures.__file__)),
                "figure_svg_helper_sha256": file_digest(Path(figures.drawing.__file__)),
                "source_scope_helper_sha256": file_digest(Path(source_scope.__file__)),
                "support_reconciliation_sha256": file_digest(Path(reconciliation.__file__))}
    operation_id = digest(identity)
    directory = workspace.root / DIRECTORY / operation_id
    directory.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    with held(directory / ".prepare.lock", blocking=False):
        record = directory / "operation.json"
        operation = read_json(record) if record.exists() else {
            "schema": SCHEMA, "id": operation_id, "identity": identity,
            "workspace_id": workspace.project["id"], "experiment_id": key,
            "selection": selected["selection"], "title": selected["selection"]["title"],
            "created_at": now(), "state": "preparing", "files": {}}
        if operation.get("identity") != identity:
            raise ValueError("The retained Parameter report has another original selection")
        source = directory / "source"
        source.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        try:
            if not operation.get("source"):
                if not (source / "sources.json").exists():
                    with held(workspace.root / "experiments" / key / ".experiment.lock", blocking=False):
                        state = parameter_studies._read(workspace, key)
                        if state.get("artifacts", {}).get("export_manifest") != identity["export_manifest"]:
                            raise ValueError("The original export edition changed during report preparation")
                        rows, ranges, records, scope = _freeze(workspace, key, source, selected, state)
                    _recipe(source, selected, rows, ranges, scope)
                recipe = read_json(source / "scientific-report.json")
                if recipe["basis"] != selected:
                    raise ValueError("The retained report recipe has another selected native result")
                for item in recipe["inputs"]:
                    verify_file(source, item)
                collection = workspace.import_sources(source / "sources.json")
                operation.update(source={"source_collection_id": collection["id"], "source_id": SOURCE_ID},
                                 state="source_ready", selected_cases=selected["cases"],
                                 selected_areas=selected["areas"], comparison_id=selected["comparison_id"])
                atomic_json(record, operation)
            else:
                workspace.source_file(operation["source"]["source_collection_id"], SOURCE_ID)
            if render:
                operation["report"] = shared._render(
                    workspace, directory, operation, read_json(source / "original-source-editions.json"))
                operation["files"].update(operation["report"]["files"])
                operation["state"] = "complete"
            for name, path in (("source_manifest", "sources.json"), ("selected_rows", "selected-results.json"),
                               ("selected_csv", "selected-results.csv"), ("report_recipe", "scientific-report.json"),
                               ("figure_specification", figures.SPEC), ("figure_coordinates", figures.COORDINATES),
                               ("figure_coordinates_json", "parameter-figure-coordinates.json"),
                               ("figure_coverage", figures.COVERAGE),
                               ("original_source_scope", source_scope.SCOPE_FILE),
                               ("support_reconciliation", reconciliation.JSON_FILE),
                               ("support_reconciliation_csv", reconciliation.CSV_FILE),
                               ("support_reconciliation_source", reconciliation.SOURCE_FILE)):
                operation["files"][name] = describe_file(workspace.root, source / path)
            operation["delivery_selection"] = shared.delivery_selection(operation["source"])
            operation.pop("error", None)
            operation["updated_at"] = now()
            atomic_json(record, operation)
            atomic_json(workspace.root / "experiments" / key / "latest-scientific-source.json",
                        {"experiment_id": key, "source_operation_id": operation_id,
                         "title": operation["title"], "state": operation["state"],
                         "artifact_sha256": operation["selection"]["expected_artifact_sha256"]})
            return get(workspace, operation_id)
        except BaseException as error:
            operation.update(error={"type": type(error).__name__, "message": str(error)}, updated_at=now())
            atomic_json(record, operation)
            raise

"""Original Parameter-study coordinates for the shared scientific figure renderer.

Every physical coordinate is copied from selected-results.json. Ordinal case
positions and axis bounds are presentation metadata, with no fitted trends.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

from collections import defaultdict
from copy import deepcopy
import csv
import io
import json
from pathlib import Path

from .common import atomic_bytes, atomic_json, digest, file_digest
from . import ensemble_scientific_figures as drawing
from .scientific_figures import _validate_figure

EDITION = 1
SPEC = "parameter-figure-spec.json"
COORDINATES = "parameter-figure-coordinates.csv"
COVERAGE = "parameter-figure-coverage.json"
PAGE_SIZE = 12
LABELS = {"nitrogen_export": "Nitrogen", "phosphorus_export": "Phosphorus",
          "sediment_export": "Sediment"}
FIELDS = ("baseline_mass", "case_mass", "change")


def _text(value):
    if value is None:
        return "Undefined"
    if isinstance(value, (list, dict)):
        return json.dumps(value, ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True, allow_nan=False)
    return str(value)


def _table(columns, rows, caption):
    return {"kind": "table", "columns": columns,
            "rows": [[_text(value) for value in row] for row in rows], "caption": caption}


def _context(row, index, selection, selected_sha256):
    return {
        "case_id": row["case_id"], "case_label": row["case"], "record_id": row["case_id"],
        "run_id": row["run_id"], "profile_id": row["profile_id"],
        "area_id": row["area_id"], "area": row["area"], "pollutant": row["pollutant"],
        "units": row["units"], "overrides": deepcopy(row["overrides"]),
        "baseline_valid_cells": row["baseline_valid_cells"],
        "case_valid_cells": row["case_valid_cells"], "paired_valid_cells": row["paired_valid_cells"],
        "paired_area_ha": row["paired_area_ha"], "support_changed": row["support_changed"],
        "baseline_full_mass": row["baseline_full_mass"], "case_full_mass": row["case_full_mass"],
        "percent_change": row["percent_change"],
        "experiment_id": selection["experiment_id"],
        "original_result_sha256": selection["expected_artifact_sha256"],
        "selected_results_sha256": selected_sha256,
        "original_row": {"path": "selected-results.json", "json_pointer": "/rows/" + str(index)},
    }


def build(selected, rows, *, selected_sha256):
    """Describe each original pair independently, including undefined coverage."""
    selection = selected["selection"]
    order = {key: index + 1 for index, key in enumerate(selection["case_ids"])}
    groups = defaultdict(list)
    for index, row in enumerate(rows):
        if (row["case_id"] not in order or row["area_id"] not in selection["area_ids"] or
                row["pollutant"] not in selection["pollutants"]):
            raise ValueError("A Parameter figure row is outside the selected original matrix")
        if not isinstance(row["units"], str) or not row["units"].strip():
            raise ValueError("Keep the original physical units beside every Parameter figure")
        groups[(row["area_id"], row["pollutant"], row["units"])].append((index, row))
    figures, omitted, coordinates = [], [], []
    total_points = 0
    for (area, pollutant, units), values in groups.items():
        values.sort(key=lambda item: order[item[1]["case_id"]])
        for page, start in enumerate(range(0, len(values), PAGE_SIZE)):
            records = values[start:start + PAGE_SIZE]
            figure_id = "parameter-" + digest([area, pollutant, units])[:20] + "-" + str(page + 1)
            mass_points = {(field, changed): [] for field in FIELDS[:2] for changed in (False, True)}
            change_points = {False: [], True: []}
            page_omitted = []
            plotted_pairs = 0
            for index, row in records:
                context = _context(row, index, selection, selected_sha256)
                position = order[row["case_id"]]
                changed = row["support_changed"]
                if type(changed) is not bool:
                    raise ValueError("Keep the original boolean support comparison in Parameter figures")
                any_point = False
                for field in FIELDS:
                    value = row[field]
                    if value is None:
                        omission = {"figure_id": figure_id, "field": field, "reason": "Original value is undefined",
                                    **deepcopy(context), "source": {
                                        "path": "selected-results.json", "json_pointer": "/rows/" + str(index) + "/" + field}}
                        omitted.append(omission)
                        page_omitted.append(omission)
                        continue
                    if drawing._number(value) is None:
                        raise ValueError("A retained Parameter figure value must be finite or explicitly undefined")
                    if row["paired_valid_cells"] <= 0:
                        raise ValueError("A finite Parameter paired value has no original valid-cell support")
                    point = {"x": position, "y": value, "field": field,
                             "source": {"path": "selected-results.json",
                                        "json_pointer": "/rows/" + str(index) + "/" + field},
                             **deepcopy(context)}
                    if field == "change":
                        change_points[changed].append(point)
                    else:
                        mass_points[(field, changed)].append(point)
                    coordinates.append({"figure_id": figure_id, **deepcopy(point)})
                    total_points += 1
                    any_point = True
                plotted_pairs += int(any_point)
            if not plotted_pairs:
                # Their exact rows remain in coverage.json and the report tables.
                continue
            positions = [order[row["case_id"]] for unused, row in records]
            x = drawing._axis("Original selected case (key below)", "",
                              [min(positions) - .6, max(positions) + .6],
                              [{"value": value, "label": str(value)} for value in positions])
            masses = [point["y"] for points in mass_points.values() for point in points]
            changes = [point["y"] for points in change_points.values() for point in points]
            panels = []
            if masses:
                series = []
                for field, title, marker in (("baseline_mass", "Baseline", "circle"),
                                             ("case_mass", "Case", "square-open")):
                    for changed in (False, True):
                        points = mass_points[(field, changed)]
                        if points:
                            series.append({"geometry": "scatter", "label": title + (" / changed support" if changed else ""),
                                           "marker": ("triangle" if field == "baseline_mass" else "cross")
                                                     if changed else marker,
                                           "points": points})
                panels.append({
                    "title": "Original annual mass on each pair's valid cells", "x": deepcopy(x),
                    "y": drawing._axis("Annual export mass", units, drawing._domain(masses, zero=True)),
                    "series": series,
                })
            if changes:
                panels.append({
                    "title": "Original case minus baseline", "x": deepcopy(x),
                    "y": drawing._axis("Annual change", units, drawing._domain(changes, zero=True)),
                    "series": [{"geometry": "scatter", "label": "Changed support" if changed else "Paired change",
                                "marker": "cross" if changed else "circle", "points": points}
                               for changed, points in change_points.items() if points],
                    "reference_lines": [{"axis": "y", "value": 0, "label": "No change"}],
                })
            figure = {
                "id": figure_id,
                "title": LABELS.get(pollutant, pollutant) + " — " + records[0][1]["area"] +
                         " — cases " + str(min(positions)) + "–" + str(max(positions)),
                "caption": (
                    "Each position is an original selected parameter case with land cover held fixed. "
                    "Values are copied from the saved annual-mass result. Each baseline/case pair uses "
                    "its own intersection of valid pixel centres; changed support is explicitly marked. "
                    "Matching counts alone do not establish matching geography across cases. "
                    "No lines, fitted trends, pooled support or probability intervals are introduced. "
                    "Negative change means lower modeled export. Undefined values have no plotted point "
                    "and remain in the coverage record and original numeric tables. Original full totals "
                    "are separate from the paired masses. Case, profile, run and support keys follow this figure."),
                "panels": panels, "area_id": area, "pollutant": pollutant, "units": units,
                "source_record_count": len(records), "plotted_record_count": plotted_pairs,
                "omitted_records": page_omitted,
                "detail_tables": [
                    _table(["Position", "Original case", "Case ID"],
                           [[order[row["case_id"]], row["case"], row["case_id"]] for unused, row in records],
                           "Figure case key; position is presentation metadata, not a parameter value."),
                    _table(["Position", "Profile ID", "Native run ID"],
                           [[order[row["case_id"]], row["profile_id"], row["run_id"]]
                            for unused, row in records],
                           "Exact original native selections; full parameter assignments remain in the coordinate JSON."),
                    _table(["Position", "Baseline cells", "Case cells", "Paired cells", "Paired area (ha)", "Changed"],
                           [[order[row["case_id"]], row["baseline_valid_cells"], row["case_valid_cells"],
                             row["paired_valid_cells"], row["paired_area_ha"], row["support_changed"]]
                            for unused, row in records],
                           "Original independent and paired support. These counts never stand in for a shared-mask identity."),
                ],
            }
            _validate_figure(figure)
            figures.append(figure)
    return {
        "schema": "upstate.scientific-figure-spec/v1", "version": EDITION,
        "experiment_id": selection["experiment_id"],
        "original_result_sha256": selection["expected_artifact_sha256"],
        "selected_results_sha256": selected_sha256,
        "figures": figures,
        "coverage": {"selected_rows": len(rows), "figure_count": len(figures),
                     "plotted_values": total_points, "undefined_values": len(omitted),
                     "omitted_records": omitted},
        "methods": ["All physical coordinates are copied from selected-results.json.",
                    "Each original case pair retains its own geographic support.",
                    "Areas, pollutants and physical units remain separate.",
                    "Case positions and padded axis bounds are presentation metadata.",
                    "No physical aggregation, smoothing, interpolation or probability inference occurs."],
        "coordinates": coordinates,
    }


def write(directory, selected, rows):
    directory = Path(directory)
    selected_sha256 = file_digest(directory / "selected-results.json")
    spec = build(selected, rows, selected_sha256=selected_sha256)
    coordinates = spec.pop("coordinates")
    atomic_json(directory / SPEC, spec, immutable=True)
    atomic_json(directory / COVERAGE, spec["coverage"], immutable=True)
    atomic_json(directory / "parameter-figure-coordinates.json", {
        "schema": "upstate.parameter-figure-coordinates/v1",
        "experiment_id": spec["experiment_id"],
        "original_result_sha256": spec["original_result_sha256"],
        "selected_results_sha256": selected_sha256, "coordinates": coordinates,
    }, immutable=True)
    figures = []
    for figure in spec["figures"]:
        path = "figures/" + figure["id"] + ".svg"
        atomic_bytes(directory / path, drawing._svg(figure).encode("utf-8"), immutable=True)
        figures.append({"id": figure["id"], "path": path})
    fields = ["figure_id", "field", "x", "y", "case_id", "case_label", "run_id", "profile_id",
              "area_id", "area", "pollutant", "units", "baseline_valid_cells", "case_valid_cells",
              "paired_valid_cells", "paired_area_ha", "support_changed", "baseline_full_mass",
              "case_full_mass", "percent_change", "original_result_sha256", "selected_results_sha256",
              "overrides", "source"]
    output = io.StringIO(newline="")
    writer = csv.DictWriter(output, fieldnames=fields, extrasaction="ignore", lineterminator="\n")
    writer.writeheader()
    for point in coordinates:
        row = {}
        for key, value in point.items():
            if isinstance(value, (dict, list)):
                value = json.dumps(value, ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True, allow_nan=False)
            if isinstance(value, str) and value.lstrip().startswith(("=", "+", "-", "@", "\t", "\r")):
                value = "'" + value
            row[key] = value
        writer.writerow(row)
    atomic_bytes(directory / COORDINATES, output.getvalue().encode("utf-8"), immutable=True)
    return {"figure_spec": SPEC, "figures": figures, "coverage": spec["coverage"]}
files.model/ensemble_parameter_studies.py:
"""Continue exact saved ensemble runs as parameter studies within each scenario.

The original ensemble remains the land-cover contrast. This continuation holds
each original scenario fixed and compares its original parameter profiles.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

from copy import deepcopy
from pathlib import Path
import argparse
import json

from .common import (atomic_json, canonical, describe_file, digest, held,
                     identifier, now, read_json, verify_file)
from .model_selection import run_models
from . import parameter_studies as studies
from . import parameter_report_source as reports

SCHEMA = "upstate.ensemble-parameter-studies/v1"
DIRECTORY = "ensemble-parameter-studies"
METHOD = (
    "Each study holds one original land-cover scenario and the original grid, "
    "forcing and coefficient source fixed. Its parameter changes are case minus "
    "the original reference profile on that pair's valid cells. The original "
    "ensemble retains land-cover effects; these are distinct scientific questions."
)


def _option(value, name, default):
    result = value.get(name, default)
    if type(result) is not bool:
        raise ValueError(name + " must be true or false")
    return result


def _axis(axis):
    refs = [value if isinstance(value, str) else canonical(value).decode("utf-8")
            for value in axis["references"]]
    return {"name": axis["id"], "parameters": list(axis["targets"]),
            "values": deepcopy(axis["values"]), "reason": axis["reason"],
            "references": refs}


def _plan(workspace, key):
    key = identifier(key)
    plan = workspace._get("ensembles", key)
    path = workspace.root / "ensembles" / (key + ".json")
    descriptor = describe_file(workspace.root, path)
    original = read_json(verify_file(workspace.root, descriptor))
    if {**original, "id": key} != plan:
        raise ValueError("The saved ensemble changed during its original source capture")
    return plan, descriptor


def _designs(workspace, value):
    if not isinstance(value, dict):
        raise ValueError("Choose an original ensemble for parameter continuation")
    allowed = {"ensemble_id", "title", "purpose", "reporting_areas",
               "difference_maps", "render_reports", "scenario_ids"}
    if set(value) - allowed:
        raise ValueError("Unknown ensemble continuation fields: " + ", ".join(sorted(set(value) - allowed)))
    plan, descriptor = _plan(workspace, value.get("ensemble_id"))
    if not plan.get("axes"):
        raise ValueError("This continuation needs the ensemble's original explicit parameter axes")
    design = {"factorial": "factorial", "one_at_a_time": "one-at-a-time"}.get(plan["design"])
    if design is None:
        raise ValueError("Retain the original factorial or one-at-a-time design")
    available = list(plan.get("scenario_ids") or
                     [plan["baseline_scenario_id"], *plan["alternative_scenario_ids"]])
    scenario_ids = value.get("scenario_ids", available)
    if (not isinstance(scenario_ids, list) or not scenario_ids
            or len(set(scenario_ids)) != len(scenario_ids)
            or any(item not in available for item in scenario_ids)):
        raise ValueError("Choose distinct scenarios from the saved original ensemble")
    scenario_ids = [key for key in available if key in scenario_ids]
    title = str(value.get("title") or plan["title"]).strip()
    purpose = str(value.get("purpose") or METHOD).strip()
    if not title or not purpose:
        raise ValueError("Name the parameter continuation and its question")
    areas = deepcopy(value.get("reporting_areas", []))
    maps = _option(value, "difference_maps", False)
    render = _option(value, "render_reports", True)
    axes = [_axis(axis) for axis in plan["axes"]]
    designs, used_runs, pending = [], set(), []
    for base_id in plan["base_profile_ids"]:
        members = [member for member in plan["members"] if member["parent_profile_id"] == base_id]
        if not members:
            continue
        base_members = [member for member in members if member["profile_id"] == base_id]
        if len(base_members) != 1:
            raise ValueError("The retained parameter group needs its exact original reference profile")
        reference_member = base_members[0]
        profiles = {member["profile_id"]: workspace._get("profiles", member["profile_id"])
                    for member in members}
        for scenario_id in scenario_ids:
            scenario = workspace._get("scenarios", scenario_id)
            baseline_choices = [run for run in reference_member["runs"]
                                if run["scenario_id"] == scenario_id]
            if len(baseline_choices) != 1:
                raise ValueError("The source member needs exactly one run for each original scenario")
            baseline = workspace.inspect_run(baseline_choices[0]["run_id"])
            active = run_models(baseline)
            selection = {
                "schema": studies.SELECTION_SCHEMA,
                "title": title + " | " + scenario["title"] + " | " + profiles[base_id]["title"],
                "purpose": purpose, "baseline_run_id": baseline["id"],
                "design": design, "axes": axes, "reporting_areas": areas,
                "difference_maps": maps}
            selection, _, profile = studies._selection(workspace, selection)
            definitions = [{"id": "baseline", "overrides": {}, "axis_values": []},
                           *list(studies._cases(selection, profile))]
            if len(definitions) < 2 or len({case["id"] for case in definitions}) != len(definitions):
                raise ValueError("The retained axes need distinct original parameter cases")
            by_signature = {}
            for member in members:
                signature = studies._profile_signature(profiles[member["profile_id"]], models=active)
                by_signature.setdefault(signature, []).append(member)
            case_runs, bindings = {}, []
            matched = set()
            for definition in definitions:
                changed = studies._apply(profile, definition["overrides"], models=active)
                signature = studies._profile_signature(changed, models=active)
                matches = by_signature.get(signature, [])
                if len(matches) != 1:
                    raise ValueError("The original ensemble does not contain exactly one matching profile "
                                     "for every parameter case; keep its original ensemble report")
                member = matches[0]
                if member["id"] in matched:
                    raise ValueError("Two parameter cases select the same original ensemble member")
                matched.add(member["id"])
                choices = [run for run in member["runs"] if run["scenario_id"] == scenario_id]
                if len(choices) != 1:
                    raise ValueError("The original member repeats or lacks the selected scenario")
                native = workspace.inspect_run(choices[0]["run_id"])
                if (native["selection"]["grid_id"] != plan["grid_id"]
                        or native["selection"]["scenario_id"] != scenario_id
                        or native["selection"]["profile_id"] != member["profile_id"]
                        or run_models(native) != active):
                    raise ValueError("The native selection differs from its original ensemble member")
                used_runs.add(native["id"])
                if native["state"] != "complete":
                    pending.append({"run_id": native["id"], "state": native["state"],
                                    "member_id": member["id"], "scenario_id": scenario_id})
                case_runs[definition["id"]] = native["id"]
                bindings.append({"case_id": definition["id"], "member_id": member["id"],
                                 "profile_id": member["profile_id"], "run_id": native["id"],
                                 "run_selection": deepcopy(native["selection"]),
                                 "assignments": deepcopy(member["assignments"])})
            if matched != {member["id"] for member in members}:
                raise ValueError("The original parameter group contains cases outside its saved axis design")
            provenance = {"identity": {
                "schema": "upstate.ensemble-parameter-origin/v1",
                "ensemble_id": plan["id"], "ensemble_plan": descriptor,
                "base_profile_id": base_id, "scenario_id": scenario_id,
                "source_axes": deepcopy(plan["axes"]), "source_design": plan["design"],
                "source_reason": plan["reason"], "members": bindings,
                "interpretation": METHOD},
                "files": [descriptor]}
            designs.append({"key": digest({"base_profile_id": base_id, "scenario_id": scenario_id}),
                            "base_profile_id": base_id, "scenario_id": scenario_id,
                            "scenario_title": scenario["title"], "selection": selection,
                            "case_runs": case_runs, "provenance": provenance})
    if not designs:
        raise ValueError("The original ensemble has no coherent retained parameter groups")
    normalized = {"ensemble_id": plan["id"], "title": title, "purpose": purpose,
                  "scenario_ids": scenario_ids, "reporting_areas": areas,
                  "difference_maps": maps, "render_reports": render}
    identity = {"schema": SCHEMA, "workspace_id": workspace.project["id"],
                "selection": normalized, "ensemble_plan": descriptor,
                "designs": designs}
    return identity, {"study_count": len(designs), "native_runs": len(used_runs),
                      "complete_native_runs": len(used_runs) - len({row["run_id"] for row in pending}),
                      "pending": pending}


def preview(workspace, value):
    identity, counts = _designs(workspace, value)
    return {"id": digest(identity), "workspace_id": workspace.project["id"],
            "ensemble_id": identity["selection"]["ensemble_id"],
            "selection": identity["selection"], "counts": counts,
            "ready": not counts["pending"], "method": METHOD,
            "studies": [{"key": row["key"], "title": row["selection"]["title"],
                         "scenario_id": row["scenario_id"], "scenario_title": row["scenario_title"],
                         "base_profile_id": row["base_profile_id"], "cases": len(row["case_runs"]),
                         "native_run_ids": list(row["case_runs"].values())}
                        for row in identity["designs"]]}


def get(workspace, operation_id):
    key = identifier(operation_id)
    directory = workspace.root / DIRECTORY / key
    state = read_json(directory / "operation.json")
    if (state.get("schema") != SCHEMA or state.get("id") != key
            or state.get("workspace_id") != workspace.project["id"]
            or digest(state["identity"]) != key
            or state.get("selection") != state["identity"]["selection"]
            or state.get("ensemble_id") != state["identity"]["selection"]["ensemble_id"]):
        raise ValueError("The saved continuation belongs to another original ensemble selection")
    verify_file(workspace.root, state["identity"]["ensemble_plan"])
    designs = {row["key"]: row for row in state["identity"]["designs"]}
    rows, seen = [], set()
    for row in state.get("studies", []):
        design = designs.get(row.get("key"))
        if design is None or row["key"] in seen:
            raise ValueError("The saved continuation repeats or substitutes an original scenario group")
        seen.add(row["key"])
        current = studies.inspect(workspace, row["experiment_id"])
        selection = current["selection"]
        if (selection.get("retained_source") != design["provenance"]
                or any(selection.get(name) != value for name, value in design["selection"].items())
                or {case["id"]: case["run_id"] for case in current["cases"]} != design["case_runs"]
                or any(row.get(name) != design[name] for name in ("scenario_id", "base_profile_id"))):
            raise ValueError("The retained study changed its original ensemble lineage")
        source = reports.get(workspace, row["source_operation_id"]) if row.get("source_operation_id") else None
        if source is not None and source["experiment_id"] != current["id"]:
            raise ValueError("The saved report source belongs to another original parameter study")
        rows.append({**row, "state": current["state"], "progress": current["progress"],
                     "source": source})
    if state.get("state") == "complete" and seen != set(designs):
        raise ValueError("The completed continuation omits an original scenario study")
    return {**state, "studies": rows}


def latest(workspace, ensemble_id):
    key = identifier(ensemble_id)
    path = workspace.root / "ensemble_results" / key / "latest-parameter-studies.json"
    if not path.exists():
        return None
    pointer = read_json(path)
    if pointer.get("ensemble_id") != key:
        raise ValueError("The saved continuation pointer names another original ensemble")
    value = get(workspace, pointer["operation_id"])
    if value["ensemble_id"] != key:
        raise ValueError("The saved continuation belongs to another original ensemble")
    return value


def continue_studies(workspace, value):
    identity, counts = _designs(workspace, value)
    if counts["pending"]:
        raise ValueError("Complete the named original ensemble runs before aggregating parameter studies: " +
                         ", ".join(row["run_id"] for row in counts["pending"]))
    key = digest(identity)
    directory = workspace.root / DIRECTORY / key
    with held(workspace.root / ".workspace.lock", blocking=False):
        directory.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        atomic_json(directory / "selection.json", identity, immutable=True)
    path = directory / "operation.json"
    with held(directory / ".bridge.lock", blocking=False):
        state = read_json(path) if path.exists() else {
            "schema": SCHEMA, "id": key, "identity": identity,
            "workspace_id": workspace.project["id"], "ensemble_id": identity["selection"]["ensemble_id"],
            "selection": identity["selection"], "created_at": now(), "state": "preparing", "studies": []}
        if state["identity"] != identity:
            raise ValueError("Retain the original ensemble continuation selection")
        state.update(state="preparing", updated_at=now())
        atomic_json(path, state)
        # Publish the pointer before derived work so the original preview can
        # reopen completed studies even if a later summary/report is interrupted.
        atomic_json(workspace.root / "ensemble_results" / state["ensemble_id"] /
                    "latest-parameter-studies.json", {"operation_id": key, "ensemble_id": state["ensemble_id"]})
        try:
            by_key = {row["key"]: row for row in state["studies"]}
            for design in identity["designs"]:
                state.update(active_study=design["key"], updated_at=now())
                atomic_json(path, state)
                retained = studies.prepare_retained(workspace, design["selection"], design["case_runs"],
                                                    provenance=design["provenance"])
                row = by_key.get(design["key"])
                if row is None:
                    row = {"key": design["key"], "experiment_id": retained["id"],
                           "scenario_id": design["scenario_id"], "scenario_title": design["scenario_title"],
                           "base_profile_id": design["base_profile_id"], "title": design["selection"]["title"]}
                    state["studies"].append(row)
                    by_key[row["key"]] = row
                    atomic_json(path, state)
                elif row["experiment_id"] != retained["id"]:
                    raise ValueError("The saved bridge changed its original Parameter study")
                # Reopen a complete original result edition without repeating its
                # raster aggregation. An interrupted summary resumes natively.
                if not retained.get("artifacts", {}).get("results"):
                    studies.summarize(workspace, retained["id"])
                else:
                    verify_file(workspace.root / "experiments" / retained["id"],
                                retained["artifacts"]["results"])
                if identity["selection"]["render_reports"]:
                    if row.get("source_operation_id"):
                        prepared = reports.get(workspace, row["source_operation_id"])
                    else:
                        choices = reports.catalog(workspace, retained["id"])
                        prepared = reports.prepare(workspace, {
                            "experiment_id": retained["id"], "title": row["title"],
                            "expected_artifact_sha256": choices["artifact_sha256"]}, render=True)
                        row["source_operation_id"] = prepared["id"]
                row["updated_at"] = now()
                atomic_json(path, state)
            state.update(state="complete", active_study=None, updated_at=now())
            state.setdefault("completed_at", now())
            state.pop("error", None)
            state["files"] = {"selection": describe_file(workspace.root, directory / "selection.json")}
            atomic_json(path, state)
            atomic_json(workspace.root / "ensemble_results" / state["ensemble_id"] /
                        "latest-parameter-studies.json", {"operation_id": key, "ensemble_id": state["ensemble_id"]})
            return get(workspace, key)
        except BaseException as error:
            state.update(state="partial", error={"type": type(error).__name__, "message": str(error)},
                         updated_at=now())
            try:
                atomic_json(path, state)
            except OSError:
                pass
            raise


def main(argv=None):
    from .workspace import Workspace
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("--workspace", required=True, type=Path)
    parser.add_argument("--ensemble-id", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--title")
    parser.add_argument("--purpose")
    parser.add_argument("--selection", type=Path,
                        help="Optional original reporting areas and scenario selection JSON")
    parser.add_argument("--preview", action="store_true")
    parser.add_argument("--no-report", action="store_true")
    parser.add_argument("--difference-maps", action="store_true")
    args = parser.parse_args(argv)
    value = read_json(args.selection) if args.selection else {}
    value["ensemble_id"] = args.ensemble_id
    for name in ("title", "purpose"):
        if getattr(args, name):
            value[name] = getattr(args, name)
    if args.no_report:
        value["render_reports"] = False
    if args.difference_maps:
        value["difference_maps"] = True
    ws = Workspace(args.workspace)
    result = preview(ws, value) if args.preview else continue_studies(ws, value)
    print(json.dumps(result, sort_keys=True, indent=2, allow_nan=False))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

"""Original source classifications, geography and assumptions for a saved ensemble.

This is a presentation/package join. It neither changes native selections nor
computes pollutant quantities. Every displayed declaration comes from retained
grid/source/profile records; original referenced documents travel as companions.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

from copy import deepcopy
import json
import math
from pathlib import Path

from .common import atomic_json, describe_file, digest, identifier
from . import ensemble_scientific_source as shared

VERSION = 2
SCOPE_FILE = "study-source-scope.json"
KNOWN_ASSUMPTIONS = ("upstate.simulated-assumptions/v1", "upstate.simulated-input-recipe/v1")
CONTROL_SCHEMA = "upstate.simulated-matched-control/v1"
GEOGRAPHIC_SCHEMA = "upstate.geographic-headwaters-assumptions/v1"
GEOGRAPHIC_FIELDS = ("classification", "question", "geography", "physical_fields",
                     "terrain", "terrain_parameters", "land_cover_pattern", "loads",
                     "parameters", "outputs", "scope", "control", "references")
ASSUMPTION_FIELDS = ("classification", "assumptions", "nutrient_loading", "runoff_scaling",
                     "retention", "sediment", "stream_threshold", "parameter_profile")


def _plain(value):
    if value is None:
        return "Not declared"
    if isinstance(value, (dict, list)):
        return json.dumps(value, ensure_ascii=False, allow_nan=False, sort_keys=True)
    if isinstance(value, float):
        return format(value, ".10g")
    return str(value)


def _table(columns, rows, caption):
    return {"kind": "table", "columns": columns,
            "rows": [[_plain(value) for value in row] for row in rows], "caption": caption}


def _references(profiles, bindings):
    uris, hashes, controls = set(), set(), set()
    for profile in profiles.values():
        for reference in profile.get("references", []):
            if not isinstance(reference, str):
                continue
            uris.add(reference)
            if reference.startswith("recipe-sha256:"):
                value = reference.split(":", 1)[1]
                if len(value) == 64 and all(c in "0123456789abcdef" for c in value):
                    hashes.add(value)
    for binding in bindings:
        entry = binding["entry"]
        for name, selected in (("recipe_sha256", hashes), ("control_sha256", controls)):
            value = entry.get(name)
            if isinstance(value, str) and len(value) == 64 and all(c in "0123456789abcdef" for c in value):
                selected.add(value)
    return uris, hashes, controls



def _geographic_references(profiles):
    """Bind a geographic edition to the profile's own retained source collection."""
    result = {}
    for profile in profiles.values():
        collection = profile.get("source_collection_id")
        if not isinstance(collection, str):
            continue
        for reference in profile.get("references", []):
            if not isinstance(reference, str) or not reference.startswith("geographic-edition:"):
                continue
            edition = reference.split(":", 1)[1]
            if len(edition) == 64 and all(c in "0123456789abcdef" for c in edition):
                result.setdefault(collection, set()).add(edition)
    return result


def _geographic_member(entry, editions):
    """Recognize only the exact declared edition and one original member name."""
    uri = entry.get("uri")
    if not isinstance(uri, str):
        return None
    for edition in sorted(editions):
        prefix = "upstate.geographic-headwaters:" + edition + "/"
        if uri.startswith(prefix):
            name = uri[len(prefix):]
            if (name and name not in (".", "..") and "/" not in name
                    and "\\" not in name and "\0" not in name):
                return {"edition_id": edition, "member": name}
    return None


def capture(workspace, directory, grid, profiles, bindings, collections):
    """Retain explicitly referenced document bodies and the original scope."""
    directory = Path(directory)
    uris, hashes, controls = _references(profiles, bindings)
    geographic_editions = _geographic_references(profiles)
    references, extra_bindings, source_records = [], [], []
    already = {(row["source_collection_id"], row["source_id"]) for row in bindings}
    for collection_id, collection in sorted(collections.items()):
        for entry in collection["entries"]:
            if entry.get("kind") != "document":
                continue
            reasons = []
            geographic = _geographic_member(entry, geographic_editions.get(collection_id, set()))
            if geographic is not None:
                reasons.append("Exact geographic-edition profile reference in its original source collection")
            if entry.get("uri") in uris:
                reasons.append("Exact original profile reference URI")
            if entry.get("body", {}).get("sha256") in hashes:
                reasons.append("Exact declared original recipe SHA256")
            if entry.get("body", {}).get("sha256") in controls:
                reasons.append("Exact declared original matched-control SHA256")
            if not reasons:
                continue
            source_id = entry["id"]
            original, verified_entry = workspace.source_file(collection_id, source_id)
            if verified_entry["body"] != entry["body"]:
                raise ValueError("Referenced original document differs from its retained source edition")
            folder = directory / "reference-sources" / identifier(collection_id) / digest(source_id)
            atomic_json(folder / "entry.json", entry, immutable=True)
            shared._copy(workspace, collection["original_manifest"],
                         folder.parent / "original-manifest.json")
            copied = []
            original_member = None
            for body in [entry["body"], *entry.get("companions", [])]:
                name = shared._member(body.get("view_path", body["filename"]))
                target = folder / "members" / name
                shared._copy(workspace, body, target)
                item = describe_file(directory, target)
                copied.append(item)
                if body is entry["body"]:
                    original_member = target
            assertions, original_control, original_geographic = {}, None, None
            if entry["body"]["bytes"] <= 2 * 1024 * 1024:
                try:
                    value = json.loads(original_member.read_bytes())
                except (UnicodeError, json.JSONDecodeError):
                    value = None
                if isinstance(value, dict) and value.get("schema") in KNOWN_ASSUMPTIONS:
                    assertions = {key: deepcopy(value[key]) for key in ASSUMPTION_FIELDS if key in value}
                if geographic is not None and isinstance(value, dict):
                    if value.get("schema") == GEOGRAPHIC_SCHEMA:
                        assertions = {key: deepcopy(value[key]) for key in GEOGRAPHIC_FIELDS if key in value}
                        original_geographic = {
                            "kind": "assumptions", "edition_id": geographic["edition_id"],
                            "schema": value["schema"], "input_summary": deepcopy(value.get("input_summary", {})),
                        }
                    elif geographic["member"] == "geographic-binding.json":
                        original_geographic = {
                            "kind": "binding", "edition_id": geographic["edition_id"],
                            "binding": {key: deepcopy(value[key]) for key in (
                                "reporting_huc12s", "model_domain_huc12s", "upstream_huc12s",
                                "method", "hydrology_scope", "areas_ha", "topology", "grid",
                                "intake_footprint_relations") if key in value},
                        }
                if isinstance(value, dict) and value.get("schema") == CONTROL_SCHEMA:
                    original_control = {key: deepcopy(value[key]) for key in (
                        "schema", "classification", "source_recipe_sha256", "source_mask_role",
                        "mask_role", "changed_cells", "changed_area_ha", "scenario", "interpretation")
                        if key in value}
                    matching = value.get("matching")
                    if isinstance(matching, dict):
                        original_control["matching"] = {
                            key: deepcopy(item) for key, item in matching.items() if key != "pairs"}
                        pairs = matching.get("pairs")
                        original_control["matching_pair_count"] = len(pairs) if isinstance(pairs, list) else None
            references.append({
                "source_collection_id": collection_id, "source_id": source_id,
                "title": entry.get("title", source_id), "uri": entry.get("uri"),
                "classification": deepcopy(entry.get("classification")), "reasons": reasons,
                "body": describe_file(directory, original_member),
                "members": copied, "original_assumptions": assertions,
                "original_control": original_control,
                "geographic_reference": geographic, "original_geographic": original_geographic,
            })
            if (collection_id, source_id) not in already:
                extra_bindings.append({
                    "source_collection_id": collection_id, "source_id": source_id,
                    "roles": ["Referenced source assumption or recipe"], "entry": deepcopy(entry),
                    "original_bytes_in_report_package": True,
                })
                source_records.append({
                    "id": "native-reference-" + digest([collection_id, source_id])[:16],
                    "source_collection_id": collection_id, "source_id": source_id,
                    "title": entry.get("title", source_id), "uri": entry.get("uri", ""),
                    "vintage": entry.get("vintage", ""), "body_sha256": entry["body"]["sha256"],
                })
    spec, native = grid["spec"], grid["grid"]
    choices = {}
    for role in ("model_domain", "reporting_area"):
        selected = spec.get(role)
        choices[role] = deepcopy(selected)
    rows = []
    for binding in [*bindings, *extra_bindings]:
        entry = binding["entry"]
        rows.append({
            "roles": deepcopy(binding["roles"]),
            "source_collection_id": binding["source_collection_id"], "source_id": binding["source_id"],
            "title": entry.get("title", binding["source_id"]),
            "classification": deepcopy(entry.get("classification")), "uri": entry.get("uri"),
            "vintage": entry.get("vintage"), "units": deepcopy(entry.get("units")),
            "original_sha256": entry["body"]["sha256"],
        })
    rectangle_area = None
    values = (native.get("width"), native.get("height"), native.get("pixel_area_ha"))
    if all(isinstance(v, (int, float)) and not isinstance(v, bool) and math.isfinite(v) and v > 0 for v in values):
        rectangle_area = values[0] * values[1] * values[2]
    result = {
        "schema": "upstate.ensemble-study-source-scope/v1", "version": VERSION,
        "grid_id": grid["id"], "grid_title": grid.get("title", spec.get("title")),
        "native_grid": deepcopy(native), "grid_rectangle_area_ha": rectangle_area,
        "geographic_source_collection_id": spec["source_collection_id"],
        "geographic_selections": choices,
        "upstream_buffer_m": spec.get("upstream_buffer_m"),
        "domain_reason": spec.get("domain_reason"),
        "input_source_classifications": rows, "referenced_documents": references,
        "quantity_endpoint": "Native annual land-origin export delivered to the modeled stream network",
        "geographic_meaning": (
            "Grid dimensions and rectangle area describe the raster envelope. Model-domain and "
            "reporting-area choices below select their original source geometry. Physical totals "
            "and differences retain the original reporting mask and paired valid support."),
    }
    atomic_json(directory / SCOPE_FILE, result, immutable=True)
    return result, extra_bindings, source_records


def _control_blocks(document, control):
    matching = control.get("matching", {})
    classes = matching.get("by_original_class", [])
    classes = classes if isinstance(classes, list) else []
    interpretation = control.get("interpretation", [])
    interpretation = interpretation if isinstance(interpretation, list) else [interpretation]
    blocks = [
        "The following values and interpretation are retained from the original selected "
        "control-input document. The existing native result sections use the completed runs "
        "and their actual reporting support.",
        _table(["Original input property", "Original value"], [
            ["Source document", document["title"]],
            ["Declared classification", control.get("classification")],
            ["Source recipe SHA256", control.get("source_recipe_sha256")],
            ["Changed input cells", control.get("changed_cells")],
            ["Changed input area (ha)", control.get("changed_area_ha")],
            ["Original matching pairs in the attached document", control.get("matching_pair_count")],
            ["Matching method", matching.get("method")],
            ["Excluded candidates", matching.get("exclusion")],
            ["Common input-grid precipitation mean (mm/year)",
             matching.get("common_grid_precipitation_mean_mm_year")],
        ], "Retained input design; native final ownership supplies the reported intervention footprint"),
        _table(["Original code", "Replacement code", "Restoration cells", "Control cells",
                "Changed input area (ha)"],
               [[row.get("from_code"), row.get("to_code"), row.get("target_cells"),
                 row.get("control_cells"), row.get("area_ha")] for row in classes],
               "Exact original class and changed-area matching"),
        _table(["Original code", "Restoration precipitation sum", "Control precipitation sum",
                "Control minus restoration sum"],
               [[row.get("from_code"), row.get("target_precipitation_sum_mm_year"),
                 row.get("control_precipitation_sum_mm_year"),
                 row.get("precipitation_sum_residual_mm_year")] for row in classes],
               "Sums of original cell precipitation values (mm/year), retained as input-matching quantities"),
        _table(["Original code", "Mean absolute paired precipitation residual (mm/year)",
                "Maximum absolute paired precipitation residual (mm/year)"],
               [[row.get("from_code"), row.get("mean_absolute_paired_precipitation_residual_mm_year"),
                 row.get("max_absolute_paired_precipitation_residual_mm_year")] for row in classes],
               "Original pairwise rainfall residuals; complete pairs remain in the attached source"),
        *[_plain(item) for item in interpretation],
        {"kind": "links", "items": [
            {"title": "Complete original matched-control selection and every pair",
             "path": document["body"]["path"]}]},
    ]
    return blocks



def _geographic_blocks(document, geographic, references):
    """Display retained preparation quantities; never infer local model benefits."""
    blocks = [
        "This geographic edition combines original public-source geography with explicitly "
        "simulated physical fields and planting assumptions. Quantities in this section "
        "describe the retained input preparation. Native finite-cell support and annual "
        "stream exports remain in the completed-result sections.",
        _table(["Original geographic source", "Retained identity"], [
            ["Source document", document["title"]],
            ["Profile-declared geographic edition", geographic["edition_id"]],
        ], "Exact geographic edition selected by the original parameter profile"),
    ]
    if geographic["kind"] == "binding":
        binding = geographic["binding"]
        areas = binding.get("areas_ha", {})
        blocks.extend([
            _table(["Original spatial selection", "Retained value"], [
                ["Reporting HUC12 IDs", binding.get("reporting_huc12s")],
                ["Complete upstream model-domain HUC12 IDs", binding.get("model_domain_huc12s")],
                ["Additional upstream HUC12 IDs", binding.get("upstream_huc12s")],
                ["Original topology", binding.get("topology")],
                ["Original selection method", binding.get("method")],
                ["Hydrologic interpretation", binding.get("hydrology_scope")],
            ], "Original topology and distinct geographic selections"),
            _table(["Original vector area", "Hectares"], [
                ["Complete upstream model domain", areas.get("model_domain")],
                ["Selected reporting HUC polygons before boundary intersection", areas.get("reporting_whole_hucs")],
                ["Selected reporting HUCs within the declared reporting boundary", areas.get("reporting_area")],
                ["Full selected utility footprint union", areas.get("utility_full_union")],
                ["Utility union within the reporting area", areas.get("utility_reporting_intersection")],
            ], "Vector-union areas; these are not pixel counts or native finite-output areas"),
        ])
        relations = binding.get("intake_footprint_relations", [])
        if isinstance(relations, list) and relations:
            blocks.append(_table(
                ["Original intake ID", "Original footprint ID", "Inside or on boundary", "Original distance (m)"],
                [[row.get("intake_id"), row.get("footprint_id"), row.get("inside_or_on_boundary"),
                  row.get("distance_m")] for row in relations],
                "Original point-to-footprint relations; no intake was moved or snapped"))
    else:
        summary = geographic.get("input_summary", {})
        summary = summary if isinstance(summary, dict) else {}
        control = summary.get("control", {})
        control = control if isinstance(control, dict) else {}
        blocks.extend([
            _table(["Prepared input support", "Cells", "Hectares"], [
                ["Whole computational domain", summary.get("domain_cells"), summary.get("domain_raster_ha")],
                ["Reporting intersection", summary.get("reporting_cells"), summary.get("reporting_raster_ha")],
                ["Corridor restoration", summary.get("changed_cells"), summary.get("changed_hectares")],
                ["Off-corridor control", summary.get("control_changed_cells"), control.get("changed_area_ha")],
            ], "Original pixel-centre preparation counts; no native output-validity claim"),
            _table(["Original matching property", "Retained value"], [
                ["Method actually used", control.get("method")],
                ["Target definition", control.get("target_definition")],
                ["Candidate definition", control.get("candidate_definition")],
                ["Input-domain precipitation mean (mm/year)", control.get("selected_domain_precipitation_mean_mm_year")],
                ["Original normalization scope", control.get("normalization_scope")],
                ["Changed-area and siting interpretation", summary.get("control_meaning")],
            ], "Original matching method and support; no method is inferred from a title"),
        ])
        classes = control.get("by_original_class", [])
        if isinstance(classes, list) and classes:
            blocks.extend([
                _table(["Original code", "Replacement", "Restoration cells", "Control cells", "Changed area (ha)"],
                       [[row.get("from_code"), row.get("to_code"), row.get("target_cells"),
                         row.get("control_cells"), row.get("changed_area_ha")] for row in classes],
                       "Original class and area balance across the reporting union"),
                _table(["Original code", "Restoration precipitation sum", "Control precipitation sum",

            {"title": "Native input and output inventory", "path": "native-input-inventory.json"},
            *[{"title": row["title"], "path": row["body"]["path"]}
              for row in scope["referenced_documents"]],
        ]},
    ]
    result = [["Original geography, source classifications and model endpoint", blocks]]
    if scope["referenced_documents"]:
        statements, links = [], []
        for document in scope["referenced_documents"]:
            links.append({"title": document["title"], "path": document["body"]["path"]})
            for name, value in document["original_assumptions"].items():
                statements.append([document["title"], name, value])
        detail = [
            "These are the retained original source statements and their exact document bodies. "
            "The selected per-case profile tables identify the parameter variants used in this design.",
            _table(["Original document", "Reference relationship", "Original SHA256"],
                   [[row["title"], row["reasons"], row["body"]["sha256"]]
                    for row in scope["referenced_documents"]],
                   "Source documents selected by exact profile URI, geographic-edition reference or declared recipe/control hash"),
        ]
        if statements:
            detail.append(_table(["Original document", "Source field", "Original statement"],
                                 statements, "Original assumptions, without reinterpretation"))
        detail.append({"kind": "links", "items": links})
        result.append(["Original referenced input assumptions and recipes", detail])
    for document in scope["referenced_documents"]:
        geographic = document.get("original_geographic")
        if geographic is not None:
            result.append(["Original geographic preparation and control support",
                           _geographic_blocks(document, geographic, scope["referenced_documents"])])
        control = document.get("original_control")
        if control is not None:
            result.append(["Original matched-control input selection", _control_blocks(document, control)])
    return result

# Continue original Ensemble runs as Parameter studies

Open **Scenario sensitivity**, open a saved ensemble, then choose **Parameter results by scenario**. The preview lists every original land-cover scenario, its original reference profile and the number of retained parameter cases. After all original native runs complete, **Prepare scenario parameter studies** queues the existing aggregation and reporting workflow.

For each original base-profile group and selected scenario, the continuation holds that land cover fixed and compares its original parameter profiles. The original ensemble remains available for land-cover contrasts. Parameter changes are case minus the original reference profile; each result retains its own paired valid support. Nitrogen and phosphorus annual mass and sediment annual mass retain their original model units and source descriptors.

## What the saved continuation contains

The saved Parameter studies bind every generated case to its exact original completed native run, profile, model selection, scenario and grid. Their immutable selections retain the original ensemble identity, complete original axis references, member assignments and native selection bodies. The original saved ensemble plan is independently copied into each study's original export members. Summaries, difference rasters, charts and scientific report sources use the maintained Parameter engines.

The bridge accepts a coherent original factorial or one-at-a-time scalar design. Every expected profile must match exactly one original member, including its coefficient table hash and original source identifiers. It preserves separate original base-profile groups. A design with missing, duplicated or unmatched cases requires its existing ensemble reporting workflow; the bridge does not substitute profiles.

The completed task opens each scenario's Parameter study and its scientific report composer. Within the study, use the saved result filters, case console, source selection and exports normally. The report includes original selected rows, coordinate tables, figure specifications, SVGs and source companions. Completed task links are recreated from the saved operation when the operator restarts.

## Original native receiving

From the actual application root in its equipped GIS environment:

```sh
python -B -m model.ensemble_parameter_studies --workspace ACTUAL_WORKSPACE --ensemble-id ORIGINAL_ENSEMBLE_ID --preview
python -B -m model.ensemble_parameter_studies --workspace ACTUAL_WORKSPACE --ensemble-id ORIGINAL_ENSEMBLE_ID
```

The second command prepares all original scenario studies, aggregates completed raster outputs and prepares their scientific report sources. It invokes no native InVEST solve and creates no new native profile or run. Use `--difference-maps` to retain the original pairwise difference rasters, or `--no-report` to prepare the native Parameter results and exports before choosing report sources individually. Optional `--selection selection.json` accepts `scenario_ids`, `reporting_areas`, `difference_maps`, `render_reports`, `title` and `purpose`; the required CLI ensemble ID binds that request.

SAME5156's completed simulated headwaters Ensemble `8cb02b0fe3b6a96782525e8aa5607621dd0a456719c6651ce07a675d9cae1ff4` contains four original profiles across three original scenarios. Its coherent routing/L-factor design continues as three four-case Parameter studies. Its 30 m, 1,296 ha square and simulated inputs remain that original demonstration geography. Actual Upper Savannah geographic modeling uses its own regional source and native operation.

## Resuming, sharing and reopening

Repeat the identical selection to reopen the same continuation. Each study ID is saved before its aggregation, and original complete result artifacts and report sources reopen without repeating finished work. An interrupted summary resumes through the existing Parameter summary checkpoints. A report failure leaves the completed native study available and the continuation partial for the same request.

The operation lives under `ensemble-parameter-studies/<operation-id>`; each ordinary Parameter study remains under `experiments/<study-id>`. Whole-Workspace export acquires the continuation lock before study/run locks and retains every original selection, copied source plan, completed output and report companion. The receiver opens the original ensemble and its saved continuation normally. Each study's own ZIP retains the original ensemble plan and its complete case-to-native-run provenance.

## API contracts

The existing queued action is `parameter-study.ensemble.continue`; payload fields match the selection above with `ensemble_id` required. The result contains the immutable continuation `id`, `ensemble_id`, `selection`, `state` and `studies[]`. Each study provides `experiment_id`, `scenario_id`, `scenario_title`, `base_profile_id`, current state/progress and its original source operation when prepared.

`GET /api/parameter-studies/ensemble-studies?workspace=WORKSPACE_KEY&id=ENSEMBLE_ID` returns the exact design preview and latest saved continuation. `model.ensemble_parameter_studies.preview`, `continue_studies`, `get` and `latest` expose the same retained workflow to original native callers. `parameter_studies.prepare_retained` is the lower-level source-bound adoption seam; it requires a complete exact case/run mapping and original source descriptors.

## Receiving the product

Use the completed original run owner and Workspace. Preview the three scenario studies, prepare them, then actually open the result tables, original annual-mass/change figures, maps when selected, HTML/PDF and ZIP members. Export and cold reopen the same Workspace; open the ensemble continuation and each saved report again. Record actual commands, run IDs and observed failures. The source/controller checks used during authoring do not substitute for that populated native/browser receiving.

# Receive original scenario Parameter reports

This course finishes the original Ensemble-to-Parameter report workflow with one resumable command. It adopts the original completed native runs, prepares one ordered scientific report containing each selected scenario's Parameter study, exports the complete editable Study, restores it, and opens the retained study and report in a fresh interpreter from the transported application.

The course keeps each scenario fixed while comparing that scenario's original parameter profiles. Land-cover effects remain in the original Ensemble. Nitrogen and phosphorus retain kg/year, sediment retains tonnes/year, and the report retains the original paired-cell support, undefined percentages, input declarations and figure source coordinates.

## Start from the current complete application

Read [CURRENT_OWNER_DIRECTION.md](../CURRENT_OWNER_DIRECTION.md), version **2026-10-13.3**, and the application's [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md). Install the current native-supervision family through its maintained guarded installer before this course. The family includes the original-run bridge, Parameter scientific figures and source scope. The complete application must already contain the maintained scientific-report, editable Parameter transfer and project-restoration modules; the installer preserves those original scientific dependencies.

Use the equipped host's actual Python, application and Workspace paths. Choose one new durable operation directory outside the application and Workspace. Preserve an active native or source-update writer; run this continuation at its existing completion boundary.

From the installed application root:

~~~sh
"$GIS_PYTHON" -B -m source_tools.receive_ensemble_parameter_reports \
  --workspace "$WORKSPACE" \
  --operation "$OWNED_OUTPUT/parameter-scenario-reports" \
  --ensemble-id "$ORIGINAL_ENSEMBLE_ID"
~~~

For the original completed SAME5156 demonstration, the retained Ensemble ID is:

~~~text
8cb02b0fe3b6a96782525e8aa5607621dd0a456719c6651ce07a675d9cae1ff4
~~~

That record contains four original parameter profiles across three original scenarios, twelve native selections in total. It is the **simulated 1,296-hectare, 120×120-cell, 30 m square**. The actual geographic Upper Savannah course is separate; its original model domain, South Carolina reporting area and utility anchors must retain their own source identities.

The default reopens the latest saved bridge for the selected Ensemble. If none exists, it prepares the original whole-scenario design with difference maps enabled and individual source rendering deferred to the combined report. Select an exact existing bridge with `--bridge-id ID`. To prepare a different explicit scenario/reporting-area choice, pass `--selection original-bridge-selection.json`. The two options are mutually exclusive. The same original selection must be used on resume; the operation freezes its normalized bridge preview before derived work.

## What completes

The command uses the existing producer and native APIs in order:

1. Continue the retained original bridge and verify the completed native case roster.
2. Freeze each Parameter specification, result descriptor, original case/run/profile IDs, model families, scenario and source provenance.
3. Register each scenario's current complete scientific source. Completed source IDs remain pinned on resume.
4. Preview, render and export one ordered SourceReports edition through the maintained shared renderer. The current source declarations and original figures travel with the selected numerical rows.
5. Export one selected Study rooted in that scientific report. The maintained Parameter lineage collector includes its editable studies, native selections, scientific inputs, report sources and original outputs.
6. Restore the Study with the ordinary NativeProjectTransfer service.
7. Start the receiver from the **restored application's own source** in a fresh Python interpreter. It reopens the original study specifications, case/run/profile selections, result hashes, source editions and report files, then checks that the received Study exposes the same report.
8. Write `START_HERE.html` over the actual restored report and original quantitative exports.

No new native model calculation is issued by this course. If a retained Parameter aggregation is unfinished, its original summary mechanism resumes from the retained native outputs. Raster difference exports likewise use the existing original outputs.

## Open the actual result

The operation directory contains:

- **START_HERE.html** — the local entrypoint to the actual scientific HTML/PDF, original quantitative results and full editable Study.
- **scientific-report.zip** — the shared native report export and original source companions, independently copied into this operation.
- **parameter-scenario-study.zip** — the complete selected editable Workspace and original application.
- **received/** — the independent restored application and Workspace.
- **result.json** — exact original study IDs, report/source editions, archive identity, actual Python paths and measured report/transfer attempt durations.
- **original-studies.json** and **receiving-selection.json** — the frozen original case, source and output bindings.
- **fresh/** — original fresh-interpreter stdout, return code and receiving result.
- **state.json** — current phase and original attempt history.

The native course prepares the usable outputs. The responsible receiving worker must then open and LOOK at the populated report, all relevant PDF pages, figure maps, quantitative files and complete archive in their real recipient viewers. Operate the included application at the presentation width and **390 px**: open the original Parameter studies, scientific source selections, result table/figure details, downloads and restored reports. Retain the actual source/hash, paths, screenshots viewed and controls exercised. A native success receipt or source check alone is not this visual inspection.

The current owner brief requires actual Upper Savannah source geography and a **30 m** model grid for that separate regional case; preserve upstream modeled domain versus South Carolina reporting mask and the four utility anchors. Tim already has GIS/hydrology/modeling capability: demonstrate production offload while he retains methods, scientific review and client relationship. Keep the inputs, scenario assumptions and parameter source editions editable. Show modeled annual N/P kg/year and sediment tonnes/year reaching streams with their actual support and elapsed history. Preserve active calculations, one writer, existing contact/spend/Actions/lab controls, and the **14:00 UTC October 13, 2026 cutoff**. Use an actual operated application recording, with natural generated narration if a video is produced, and pass this complete instruction onward with the result.

## Resume the same operation

Repeat the original command with the same operation directory and arguments. Completed bridge studies, report sources, rendered report editions, Study archive and receiving directory reopen under their original IDs. The current native transfer service verifies retained archive members and preserves recipient work. A changed original result or scientific selection surfaces directly rather than silently replacing the frozen report.

The course saves its phase before each operation. A lost reply after a completed report is reconciled from the original retained preview and native report operation. Source-formatting code may advance while an incomplete source phase is retried; already saved source IDs stay pinned. The selected native runs are never rebuilt to satisfy a report-formatting update.

Read the exact phase and exception in `state.json`, and the named file under `fresh/` for a fresh-process failure. Fix that concrete source or environment problem and repeat the same command. Each actual attempt records start/end times and measured elapsed seconds. Those are report/transfer execution times, not substituted native-model timings.

The operation does not open an operator URL, change a managed browser policy, launch another runtime service, send client communications or restart a running scientific cohort. Use the original equipped browser owner's existing application at its normal receiving boundary.
