"""Editable original Parameter studies behind selected scientific-report editions.

The report's frozen source remains unchanged. Same-project transfers additionally
carry its original study specification, current checkpoint, prepared native cases
and source/rasters. Different-project report sources retain their captured inputs
without inventing an editable producer in the recipient Workspace.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

from copy import deepcopy
from pathlib import PurePosixPath

from .common import digest, identifier, read_json, relative_file
from .model_selection import selected

BASIS = "saved_parameter_study"
SOURCE_ID = "saved-parameter-study"
DIRECTORY = "parameter-report-sources"
REPORT_SCHEMA = "upstate.observed-report/v1"
STUDY_SCHEMA = "upstate.parameter-experiment/v1"
OPERATION_SCHEMA = "upstate.parameter-report-source/v1"
CONTEXT = "parameter_study"


def _relative(value):
    if not isinstance(value, str) or "\\" in value or "\0" in value:
        raise ValueError("A Parameter source needs canonical original member paths")
    path = PurePosixPath(value)
    if (path.is_absolute() or not path.parts or ".." in path.parts
            or path.as_posix() != value or any(":" in part for part in path.parts)):
        raise ValueError("A Parameter source member must remain inside its original directory")
    return value


def _same(first, second):
    return all(first.get(name) == second.get(name) for name in ("bytes", "sha256"))


def _body(closure, item):
    closure.add_file(item["object"], item)
    return closure.read(item["object"])


def _immutable(value, kind, key):
    raw = {name: item for name, item in value.items() if name != "id"}
    if (value.get("id") != key or raw.get("schema") != "upstate." + kind + "/v1"
            or digest(raw) != key):
        raise ValueError("The original Parameter " + kind + " changed its retained identity")
    return raw


def _cases(state):
    cases = state.get("cases")
    if not isinstance(cases, list) or not cases:
        raise ValueError("The original Parameter design has no prepared cases")
    indexed = {}
    for case in cases:
        key = case.get("id")
        if not isinstance(key, str) or not key or key in indexed:
            raise ValueError("The original Parameter design repeats or omits a case identity")
        for name in ("profile_id", "run_id"):
            identifier(case.get(name))
        indexed[key] = case
    baseline = indexed.get("baseline")
    if (baseline is None or baseline["run_id"] != state["selection"].get("baseline_run_id")
            or baseline["profile_id"] != state["baseline_selection"].get("profile_id")
            or digest(state["baseline_selection"]) != baseline["run_id"]):
        raise ValueError("The Parameter reference differs from its original saved baseline")
    return indexed


def _captured(closure, entry):
    recipe = _body(closure, entry["body"])
    basis = recipe.get("basis")
    metadata = entry["metadata"]
    if (entry.get("kind") != "document" or entry.get("id") != SOURCE_ID
            or metadata.get("report_schema") != REPORT_SCHEMA
            or recipe.get("schema") != REPORT_SCHEMA or not isinstance(basis, dict)):
        raise ValueError("The Parameter source differs from its declared producer")
    selection = basis.get("selection")
    if not isinstance(selection, dict):
        raise ValueError("The Parameter source lost its original selected result")
    key = identifier(selection.get("experiment_id"))
    result_sha = identifier(selection.get("expected_artifact_sha256"))
    project = selection.get("workspace_id")
    if (type(selection.get("edition")) is not int or selection["edition"] not in (1, 2, 3)
            or not isinstance(project, str) or not project
            or metadata.get("experiment_id") != key or recipe.get("edition") != result_sha
            or entry.get("uri") != "urn:upstate:parameter-study:" + key + ":" + result_sha):
        raise ValueError("The Parameter source changed its original project/study/result binding")
    members = {}
    for item in entry.get("companions", []):
        name = _relative(item.get("view_path", item["filename"]))
        if name in members:
            raise ValueError("The Parameter source repeats an original companion")
        closure.add_file(item["object"], item)
        members[name] = item
    inputs = recipe.get("inputs")
    if not isinstance(inputs, list) or not inputs:
        raise ValueError("The Parameter source has no original input inventory")
    seen = set()
    for item in inputs:
        name = _relative(item["path"])
        if name in seen or name not in members or not _same(item, members[name]):
            raise ValueError("The Parameter source lost an exact original input: " + name)
        seen.add(name)

    def original(name):
        if name not in seen:
            raise ValueError("The Parameter source lacks its original " + name)
        return _body(closure, members[name])

    if original("selection.json") != basis:
        raise ValueError("The Parameter report recipe and selected result differ")
    checkpoint = original("original-study/checkpoint.json")
    if (checkpoint.get("schema") != STUDY_SCHEMA or checkpoint.get("id") != key
            or checkpoint.get("workspace_id") != project):
        raise ValueError("The Parameter source checkpoint belongs to another study")
    cases = _cases(checkpoint)
    spec = {name: value for name, value in checkpoint["selection"].items() if name not in ("id", "schema")}
    spec["schema"] = "upstate.experiment-specs/v1"
    if digest(spec) != key:
        raise ValueError("The captured Parameter design changed its immutable specification")
    adopted = checkpoint["selection"].get("retained_native_cases")
    if adopted is not None:
        roster = [{name: deepcopy(case[name]) for name in (
            "id", "label", "overrides", "axis_values", "run_id", "profile_id", "run_selection")}
                  for case in checkpoint["cases"]]
        if roster != adopted:
            raise ValueError("The Parameter source changed its adopted original native cases")
    chosen = selection.get("case_ids")
    if (not isinstance(chosen, list) or not chosen or len(set(chosen)) != len(chosen)
            or any(case not in cases for case in chosen)
            or [case.get("id") for case in basis.get("cases", [])] != chosen):
        raise ValueError("The Parameter source changed its selected case order")
    for case in basis["cases"]:
        if any(case.get(name) != cases[case["id"]].get(name)
               for name in ("label", "run_id", "profile_id", "overrides", "axis_values")):
            raise ValueError("The selected Parameter case differs from its original design")
    artifact = checkpoint.get("artifacts", {}).get("results")
    if (not isinstance(artifact, dict) or artifact.get("sha256") != result_sha
            or not _same(artifact, members.get("original-study/" + _relative(artifact["path"]), {}))):
        raise ValueError("The Parameter source lost its exact original results")
    exported = checkpoint.get("artifacts", {}).get("export_manifest")
    if not isinstance(exported, dict):
        raise ValueError("The Parameter source lost its native export manifest")
    manifest_name = "original-study/" + _relative(exported["path"])
    manifest = original(manifest_name)
    if (not _same(exported, members[manifest_name])
            or manifest.get("schema") != "upstate.parameter-export-members/v1"
            or manifest.get("study_id") != key or manifest.get("workspace_id") != project
            or manifest.get("selection_sha256") != digest(checkpoint["selection"])):
        raise ValueError("The Parameter export manifest changed its original study selection")
    names = set()
    for item in manifest.get("files", []):
        name = "original-study/" + _relative(item["path"])
        if name in names or name not in seen or not _same(item, members.get(name, {})):
            raise ValueError("The Parameter source lost a complete original export: " + name)
        names.add(name)
    inventory = original("native-input-inventory.json")
    grid = original("grid.json")
    if (inventory.get("workspace_id") != project or inventory.get("experiment_id") != key
            or inventory.get("baseline_selection") != checkpoint.get("baseline_selection")
            or inventory.get("grid") != grid
            or grid.get("id") != checkpoint["baseline_selection"].get("grid_id")
            or digest({"spec": grid.get("spec"), "grid": grid.get("grid")}) != grid.get("id")):
        raise ValueError("The Parameter source changed its original reference grid or inputs")
    for profile in {cases[case]["profile_id"] for case in chosen}:
        _immutable(original("profiles/" + profile + ".json"), "profiles", profile)
    reference_profile = checkpoint["baseline_selection"]["profile_id"]
    # Older source editions could omit an unplotted reference profile. Its exact
    # live immutable profile is still included below; the captured source is not rewritten.
    if "profiles/" + reference_profile + ".json" in seen:
        _immutable(original("profiles/" + reference_profile + ".json"), "profiles", reference_profile)
    if basis.get("reference") is not None:
        expected = {"run_id": checkpoint["selection"]["baseline_run_id"],
                    "profile_id": reference_profile,
                    "scenario_id": checkpoint["baseline_selection"]["scenario_id"],
                    "grid_id": grid["id"], "run_selection": checkpoint["baseline_selection"]}
        if basis["reference"] != expected:
            raise ValueError("The Parameter source changed its fixed comparison reference")
    return recipe, basis, checkpoint, cases, inventory, members, seen


def _operation(closure, operation_id, study_id, project):
    prefix = DIRECTORY + "/" + identifier(operation_id)
    operation = closure.read(prefix + "/operation.json")
    identity = operation.get("identity")
    if (operation.get("schema") != OPERATION_SCHEMA or operation.get("id") != operation_id
            or operation.get("workspace_id") != project or operation.get("experiment_id") != study_id
            or not isinstance(identity, dict) or digest(identity) != operation_id
            or operation.get("selection") != identity.get("selection")
            or operation["selection"].get("experiment_id") != study_id
            or operation["selection"].get("workspace_id") != project):
        raise ValueError("The editable Parameter source changed its original operation")
    source = operation.get("source")
    if not isinstance(source, dict) or source.get("source_id") != SOURCE_ID:
        raise ValueError("The Parameter source operation has no retained source edition")
    collection_id = identifier(source.get("source_collection_id"))
    collection = closure.read("sources/" + collection_id + ".json")
    if collection.get("schema") != "upstate.sources/v1" or digest(collection) != collection_id:
        raise ValueError("The Parameter operation source collection changed")
    entries = [entry for entry in collection.get("entries", []) if entry.get("id") == SOURCE_ID]
    if len(entries) != 1:
        raise ValueError("The Parameter operation lost its original source document")
    closure.need("sources", collection_id, "Original editable Parameter scientific source")
    closure.tree(prefix)
    for item in operation.get("files", {}).values():
        closure._descriptors(item)
    return operation, entries[0]


def _local(closure, collection_id, entry, recipe, basis, captured, cases, inventory, members, seen):
    key, project = captured["id"], captured["workspace_id"]
    prefix = "experiments/" + key
    spec = closure.read("experiment-specs/" + key + ".json")
    if spec.get("schema") != "upstate.experiment-specs/v1" or digest(spec) != key:
        raise ValueError("The original Parameter specification changed")
    state = closure.read(prefix + "/experiment.json")
    expected = {name: value for name, value in spec.items() if name != "schema"}
    for checkpoint in (captured, state):
        if (checkpoint.get("schema") != STUDY_SCHEMA or checkpoint.get("id") != key
                or checkpoint.get("workspace_id") != project
                or {name: value for name, value in checkpoint.get("selection", {}).items()
                    if name != "schema"} != expected
                or checkpoint.get("baseline_selection") != captured["baseline_selection"]):
            raise ValueError("The editable Parameter study changed its original specification")
    current_cases = _cases(state)
    if list(current_cases) != list(cases):
        raise ValueError("The editable Parameter study changed its original case order")
    required = []
    for case_id, original in cases.items():
        current = current_cases[case_id]
        if any(current.get(name) != original.get(name) for name in
               ("label", "profile_id", "run_id", "overrides", "axis_values", "run_selection")):
            raise ValueError("The editable Parameter study changed a prepared case selection")
        run_id = current["run_id"]
        run = closure.read("runs/" + run_id + "/run.json")
        selection = run.get("selection")
        if (run.get("id") != run_id or not isinstance(selection, dict) or digest(selection) != run_id
                or selection.get("profile_id") != current["profile_id"]
                or any(selection.get(name) != state["baseline_selection"].get(name)
                       for name in ("grid_id", "scenario_id"))
                or selected(selection) != selected(state["baseline_selection"])
                or ("run_selection" in current and selection != current["run_selection"])
                or ("run_selection" not in current and selection.get("invest_version") !=
                    state["baseline_selection"].get("invest_version"))
                or (case_id == "baseline" and selection != state["baseline_selection"])):
            raise ValueError("The original prepared Parameter run changed its inputs")
        closure.need("runs", run_id, "Original Parameter case, including unfinished cases")
        required.append({"kind": "runs", "id": run_id})
    closure._native_selection(state["baseline_selection"], "Original Parameter comparison reference")
    closure._source_refs(state["selection"], "Original Parameter reporting-area sources")
    for binding in inventory.get("source_bindings", []):
        original_collection = identifier(binding.get("source_collection_id"))
        value = closure.read("sources/" + original_collection + ".json")
        found = [item for item in value.get("entries", []) if item.get("id") == binding.get("source_id")]
        if (value.get("schema") != "upstate.sources/v1" or digest(value) != original_collection
                or len(found) != 1 or found[0] != binding.get("entry")):
            raise ValueError("The editable Parameter source lost an original input edition")
        closure.need("sources", original_collection, "Original Parameter input source edition")
    if closure.read("grids/" + inventory["grid"]["id"] + "/grid.json") != inventory["grid"]:
        raise ValueError("The editable Parameter grid differs from its report source")
    for name in seen:
        if name.startswith("profiles/") and name.endswith(".json"):
            profile = identifier(name[len("profiles/"):-len(".json")])
            original = _body(closure, members[name])
            if closure.read("profiles/" + profile + ".json") != _immutable(original, "profiles", profile):
                raise ValueError("The editable Parameter profile differs from the selected report")
            closure.need("profiles", profile, "Original Parameter report coefficient profile")
    # Keep an interrupted export exactly as captured. The ordinary portable
    # Parameter verifier marks missing/changed declared exports for refresh.
    closure.tree(prefix)
    for comparison in {captured.get("comparison_id"), state.get("comparison_id"), basis.get("comparison_id")} - {None}:
        comparison = identifier(comparison)
        record = closure.read("comparisons/" + comparison + "/comparison.json")
        cohort = [record.get("baseline_run_id"), *[row.get("run_id") for row in record.get("alternatives", [])]]
        if (record.get("baseline_run_id") != state["selection"]["baseline_run_id"]
                or any(run_id not in {case["run_id"] for case in cases.values()} for run_id in cohort)):
            raise ValueError("The Parameter comparison belongs to another original run cohort")
        closure.need("comparisons", comparison, "Original Parameter native comparison")
        if comparison in {captured.get("comparison_id"), basis.get("comparison_id")}:
            required.append({"kind": "comparisons", "id": comparison})
    # Find the exact retained producer through its original source binding, not a
    # computed new producer hash. A later code edition can share identical inputs.
    matched = []
    directory = closure.root / DIRECTORY
    for path in sorted(directory.glob("*/operation.json")):
        operation_id = identifier(path.parent.name)
        operation = read_json(relative_file(closure.root,
            DIRECTORY + "/" + operation_id + "/operation.json"))
        if (operation.get("workspace_id") == project and operation.get("experiment_id") == key
                and operation.get("selection") == basis["selection"]
                and operation.get("source") == {"source_collection_id": collection_id, "source_id": SOURCE_ID}):
            operation, imported = _operation(closure, operation_id, key, project)
            if not _same(imported["body"], entry["body"]):
                raise ValueError("The editable Parameter operation changed its selected report source")
            source_prefix = DIRECTORY + "/" + operation_id + "/source/"
            if closure.read(source_prefix + "scientific-report.json") != recipe:
                raise ValueError("The editable Parameter recipe differs from its imported source")
            for name in seen:
                closure.add_file(source_prefix + name, members[name])
            matched.append(operation_id)
    if not matched:
        raise ValueError("The selected Parameter report lost its original editable source operation")
    pointer_path = prefix + "/latest-scientific-source.json"
    if (closure.root / pointer_path).exists() or (closure.root / pointer_path).is_symlink():
        pointer = closure.read(pointer_path)
        if pointer.get("experiment_id") != key:
            raise ValueError("The Parameter source pointer belongs to another study")
        _operation(closure, pointer["source_operation_id"], key, project)
    token = ("parameter-studies", key)
    node = closure.nodes.setdefault(token, {"kind": token[0], "id": key,
        "title": state["selection"]["title"], "state": state.get("state"), "reasons": []})
    reason = "Original editable Parameter design for selected scientific report"
    if reason not in node["reasons"]:
        node["reasons"].append(reason)
    required.append({"kind": token[0], "id": key})
    return sorted({(row["kind"], row["id"]) for row in required})


def include_source(closure, collection_id, entry):
    metadata = entry.get("metadata") or {}
    if metadata.get("source_basis") != BASIS:
        return False
    recipe, basis, captured, cases, inventory, members, seen = _captured(closure, entry)
    local = captured["workspace_id"] == closure.workspace.project["id"]
    required = _local(closure, collection_id, entry, recipe, basis, captured, cases,
                      inventory, members, seen) if local else []
    binding = {
        "schema": "upstate.study-report-lineage/v1",
        "source_collection_id": collection_id, "source_id": entry["id"],
        "source_body_sha256": entry["body"]["sha256"],
        "source_project_id": captured["workspace_id"], "report_context_kind": CONTEXT,
        "experiment_id": captured["id"], "selection": deepcopy(basis["selection"]),
        "baseline_run_id": captured["selection"]["baseline_run_id"],
        "baseline_selection": deepcopy(captured["baseline_selection"]),
        "relationship": "same_project" if local else "external_project",
        "required_records": [{"kind": kind, "id": key} for kind, key in required],
    }
    token = (collection_id, entry["id"])
    previous = closure.report_source_records.get(token)
    if previous is not None and previous != binding:
        raise ValueError("The selected Parameter report lineage changed during capture")
    closure.report_source_records[token] = binding
    return True


def lock_paths(closure):
    paths = set()
    for record in closure.report_source_records.values():
        if record.get("report_context_kind") == CONTEXT and record.get("relationship") == "same_project":
            paths.add("experiments/" + identifier(record["experiment_id"]) + "/.experiment.lock")
    for prefix in closure.trees:
        pieces = prefix.split("/")
        if len(pieces) == 2 and pieces[0] == DIRECTORY:
            paths.add(prefix + "/.prepare.lock")
    return sorted(paths)

"""Original Parameter studies in the selected-Study receiving view.

Frozen report inputs stay tied to their captured edition. Same-project sources
also open the retained editable study through the ordinary Parameter studies desk.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

from collections import Counter
from copy import deepcopy
from pathlib import PurePosixPath

from .common import digest, identifier
from . import parameter_study_transfer as transfer

SCHEMA = "upstate.received-parameter-study/v1"


def summary(identity):
    rows = [row for row in identity.get("scientific_report_sources", [])
            if row.get("report_context_kind") == transfer.CONTEXT]
    return {
        "parameter_study_source_count": len(rows),
        "editable_parameter_study_count": len({
            row["experiment_id"] for row in rows
            if row.get("relationship") == "same_project"
        }),
    }


def _member(closure, item, label):
    path = item.get("object", item.get("path"))
    if not isinstance(path, str):
        raise ValueError("The received Parameter source lost an original member path.")
    closure.add_file(path, item)
    actual = closure.files[path]
    if actual.get("sha256") is None:
        closure.read(path)
        actual = closure.files[path]
    return {"path": path, "bytes": actual["bytes"], "sha256": actual["sha256"],
            "filename": item.get("filename") or PurePosixPath(label or path).name,
            "label": label or item.get("filename") or PurePosixPath(path).name}


def _state(state):
    cases = state["cases"]
    counts = Counter(row.get("state") or "unspecified" for row in cases)
    return {
        "state": state.get("state"), "case_count": len(cases),
        "case_states": dict(sorted(counts.items())),
        "progress": deepcopy(state.get("progress", {})),
        "comparison_id": state.get("comparison_id"),
    }


def augment(closure, retained, result):
    """Use the same verified source resolver and exact original source members."""
    identity = retained["identity"]
    rows = [row for row in identity.get("scientific_report_sources", [])
            if row.get("report_context_kind") == transfer.CONTEXT]
    result.update(summary(identity))
    result["parameter_study_sources"] = []
    for captured in rows:
        token = (captured["source_collection_id"], captured["source_id"])
        if closure.report_source_records.get(token) != captured:
            raise ValueError("The received Study changed its original Parameter lineage.")
        collection_id = identifier(token[0])
        collection = closure.read("sources/" + collection_id + ".json")
        if collection.get("schema") != "upstate.sources/v1" or digest(collection) != collection_id:
            raise ValueError("The received Parameter source collection changed.")
        entries = [entry for entry in collection.get("entries", []) if entry.get("id") == token[1]]
        if len(entries) != 1 or entries[0]["body"]["sha256"] != captured["source_body_sha256"]:
            raise ValueError("The received Parameter source lost its exact original document.")
        entry = entries[0]
        recipe, basis, checkpoint, cases, inventory, members, seen = transfer._captured(closure, entry)
        key = identifier(checkpoint["id"])
        if (key != captured["experiment_id"]
                or checkpoint["workspace_id"] != captured["source_project_id"]
                or basis["selection"] != captured["selection"]):
            raise ValueError("The received Parameter report changed its original study selection.")
        local = captured["relationship"] == "same_project"
        current = None
        if local:
            if captured["source_project_id"] != closure.workspace.project["id"]:
                raise ValueError("The editable Parameter study belongs to another original project.")
            required = {(row["kind"], row["id"]) for row in captured["required_records"]}
            if ("parameter-studies", key) not in required or ("parameter-studies", key) not in closure.nodes:
                raise ValueError("The received Parameter source lost its editable study.")
            current = closure.read("experiments/" + key + "/experiment.json")
            if current.get("id") != key or current.get("schema") != transfer.STUDY_SCHEMA:
                raise ValueError("The retained Parameter checkpoint changed its identity.")
        elif captured["relationship"] != "external_project":
            raise ValueError("Choose an original Parameter source relationship.")
        source = {"source_collection_id": collection_id, "source_id": token[1]}
        original_members = [_member(closure, entry["body"], "Scientific source recipe")]
        original_members.extend(_member(closure, item, name)
                                for name, item in sorted(members.items()))
        exported_members = [_member(closure, item, name.removeprefix("original-study/"))
                            for name, item in sorted(members.items())
                            if name.startswith("original-study/")]
        result["parameter_study_sources"].append({
            "schema": SCHEMA, "source": source, "experiment_id": key,
            "title": checkpoint["selection"]["title"],
            "purpose": checkpoint["selection"].get("purpose"),
            "design": checkpoint["selection"].get("design"),
            "source_project_id": captured["source_project_id"],
            "source_body_sha256": captured["source_body_sha256"],
            "source_result_sha256": basis["selection"]["expected_artifact_sha256"],
            "relationship": captured["relationship"], "editable": local,
            "baseline_run_id": checkpoint["selection"]["baseline_run_id"],
            "baseline_selection": deepcopy(checkpoint["baseline_selection"]),
            "models": deepcopy(checkpoint.get("models", [])),
            "pollutants": deepcopy(checkpoint.get("pollutants", [])),
            "selected_case_ids": deepcopy(basis["selection"]["case_ids"]),
            "selected_cases": [{"id": row["id"], "label": row["label"],
                               "run_id": row["run_id"], "profile_id": row["profile_id"],
                               "state": cases[row["id"]].get("state")}
                              for row in basis["cases"]],
            "captured_state": _state(checkpoint),
            "current_state": _state(current) if current is not None else None,
            "source_selection": deepcopy(basis["selection"]),
            "report_ids": [row["id"] for row in result.get("reports", [])
                           if source in row.get("source_choices", [])],
            "source_members": original_members, "result_members": exported_members,
        })
    return result

"""Authenticated original Parameter source downloads in received Studies."""
from pathlib import Path


def decorate(operator, workspace_key, result):
    workspace = operator.ws(workspace_key)

    def tickets(members):
        rows = []
        for member in members:
            path = Path(workspace.root) / member["path"]
            rows.append(operator._ticket(
                workspace_key, str(path), member,
                member.get("label") or path.name))
        return rows

    for source in result.get("parameter_study_sources", []):
        source["_downloads"] = tickets(source["source_members"])
        source["_result_downloads"] = tickets(source["result_members"])
    return result

# Continue parameter studies in a received workspace

The complete Workspace archive and Project transfer keep the original parameter study selection, native case identities, partial completion state and every retained result descriptor together. The transfer summary identifies each study, native models, case completion, retained result files and original difference maps.

In **Transfer and restore**, capture the current workspace or receive its existing snapshot and parts. **Inspect and restore** shows the retained parameter studies alongside fieldwork and source acquisitions. After **Restore editable workspace** completes, choose **Open saved study** on the study row. The original application selects the received workspace and opens that exact saved study in **Parameter studies**, where its current case results and authenticated report, CSV, JSON, GeoTIFF and complete ZIP downloads are available.

A partial study opens with its original cases and selections. Use its ordinary **Resume remaining cases** action to continue. A completed study keeps its original results; **Refresh completed results** builds a current export edition from its retained native outputs. Opening the study never starts a simulation.

The capture records the original study checkpoint and selection SHA256, case/run/profile identities and every result file descriptor. Restoration joins those records to the original Workspace and checks the saved study relationships without executing the transported application. The same semantic summary is recovered after a lost receiving reply. Older archives without the summary remain readable: the receiver derives it from their retained native study files.

The report links and large GIS members are the files produced by the maintained parameter-study export workflow. Full result archives preserve their nested paths. Capture and restore use the existing complete Workspace locks, transfer queue, original file checks and create-only destination behavior.

If a prior export stopped between writing files and committing its result descriptors, the transfer preserves both the exact captured files and the original declared descriptors. The summary identifies exports needing refresh, allowing the complete recoverable workspace to travel. Matched exports retain the original byte count and SHA256. Scientific selections and case bindings remain validated by the native study API.

## Report completed native cases from a partial study

A partially completed study already contains usable comparisons when its original
baseline and one or more selected native cases have completed. In **Parameter
studies**, open that same saved study and use **Refresh completed results** when
its retained report needs refreshing. This summarizes the original completed
outputs under the study lock. **Resume remaining cases** is the separate action
that continues unfinished native execution.

Use the study's scientific-report selection to choose its completed cases,
reporting areas and pollutants. The selection is pinned to the original
`results.json` SHA256. If a newer result edition arrives while choosing, review
the refreshed selection before preparing the report. The prepared scientific
source retains the original study export manifest, native arguments, case and
profile identities, requested maps, source editions and exact numeric files.
It can be appended to the existing ordered report in **Source reports**.

The report distinguishes completed cases in the saved result edition, total cases
in the original design, and the subset selected for presentation. A report of all
currently completed cases can still represent a partial original design.
Unfinished cases contribute no substitute value. Selecting fewer completed cases
does not calculate a new minimum or maximum.

The original reference remains the study's saved `baseline_run_id`, with its
actual profile, scenario and grid. Excluding the baseline's displayed row does not
change that reference. The case position printed in the tables and figures is an
index into the selected case order in this immutable report edition. It is not a
parameter value, execution rank or effectiveness ranking. Use the adjacent case,
run and profile keys to identify a result across reporting areas and pollutants.

### Interpret the separate quantity and support tables

Read each area and pollutant separately, using the original annual-mass units.

| Report quantity | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| Paired baseline and case mass | Original annual mass summed only over cells where both runs have valid, finite values in the selected reporting area. |
| Signed change | Original case mass minus its original baseline mass on those paired cells. A negative value indicates lower modeled export. |
| Percentage change | Stored signed change divided by paired baseline mass, times 100. A zero paired baseline leaves the percentage undefined even when the absolute change exists. |
| Paired cells | Count of valid cells shared by the baseline and case inside that area. |
| Baseline and case valid cells | Each run's own valid-cell count inside the area; these counts may differ. |
| Independent full masses | Each run's total on its own valid cells. They can cover different areas and therefore are not substitutes for the paired comparison. |
| Paired area | Retained paired-cell count multiplied by the original affine pixel area; the source stores the resulting hectares. |
| Support changed | The original paired mask differs from at least one run's own valid mask in the selected area. |

When there are no paired valid cells, paired masses, signed change and percentage
are undefined. An independent full mass can still exist for a run with its own
valid cells. When a run has no own valid cells, that full mass is undefined too.
A reported zero is a defined numeric result and remains distinct from an
undefined or absent value.

Counts describe the native valid cells used by the comparison. They are not
percentages of the entire catchment, land area or population. The reporting
polygon is intersected with the original reporting extent using pixel centres.
Different reporting polygons can overlap, so do not add their loads without
checking their geographic relationship. The full reporting area and its
subcatchments describe alternative reporting scopes, not additional independent
loads.

Native capture has already converted source densities to annual mass per pixel
using the original affine pixel area. This report copies the saved mass results.
Do not multiply them by pixel area again. Use each original grid's CRS,
resolution and affine area; a cell count has no universal hectare conversion.

### Read ranges and parameter responses

The original saved ranges describe completed cases with nonempty paired support
and support identical to the fixed original baseline, grouped by reporting area
and pollutant. They include the baseline itself when it meets those conditions.
The report preserves those original ranges only when every completed case is
selected; choosing a subset does not create a new range.

The changed-support count in a range record counts cases that have paired mass
but whose valid support differs. It does not include cases with no paired mass.
Read those cases' coverage rows separately. A partial study's minimum and maximum
describe only its completed evaluated cases, not its unfinished design, a
probability interval, a confidence interval or an optimization result.

A response per parameter unit is retained only for a single numeric changed
parameter with a defined mass change and a nonzero parameter step. It is the
stored mass change divided by that finite step. Its parameter name and original
baseline and case values are part of the interpretation. Elasticity additionally
requires nonzero baseline mass and baseline parameter value. Multiple changed
parameters, categorical routing choices, unchanged parameter values and missing
numeric defaults have no such single-parameter response. Preserve absent or
undefined values instead of treating them as zero.

Land cover stays fixed within a parameter study. These results compare parameter
or routing assumptions for that landscape. A restoration-versus-baseline
comparison belongs to its original separate landscape pair, with its own selected
profiles and spatial support.

### Open maps, figures and the original files

Figures use the same selected-case positions and original physical values as the
tables. An undefined physical quantity has no plotted point; its original row
and reason remain available. The case key and coverage tables beside the figure
identify its run, profile and actual support. Inspect the figure's original
coordinate file and the selected JSON or CSV when tracing an individual point.

The requested difference GeoTIFFs retain their original comparison extent, grid,
units and paired support. Their cell values are case minus baseline annual mass
per pixel. Selecting a reporting polygon for a table does not clip or resample
the original map. Keep the extracted directories intact so report links resolve.
The scientific-source package retains the complete original study exports; the
full editable Workspace carries the larger model inputs and native rasters.

To reopen a completed partial report directly in the existing application
environment:

```python
from model.workspace import Workspace
from model import parameter_report_source

workspace = Workspace("/absolute/path/to/retained/workspace")
catalog = parameter_report_source.catalog(workspace, original_study_id)
source = parameter_report_source.prepare(workspace, {
    "experiment_id": catalog["experiment_id"],
    "expected_artifact_sha256": catalog["artifact_sha256"],
}, render=True)
# source["delivery_selection"] joins this source to the existing report workflow.
```

The original study ID comes from its saved record. In a Gura suite, each
`studies[]` item stores its actual `study_id` and `reference_run_id`; the suite
ID itself is not a study ID or an Ensemble ID. Keep the original result edition,
Workspace and case identities through the report and receiving operation.


## Transfer the selected scientific report with its editable Parameter study

Open the completed scientific report edition in **Sources → Saved scientific
reports** and choose **Transfer this report and its studies**. The existing
**Study transfer** desk selects that exact saved edition. **Preview contents**
now follows each original Parameter scientific source to its saved specification,
current checkpoint and complete prepared case cohort. Choose **Export editable
study**, then use the original download and **Receive study archive** flow.

This is the Parameter family stored as `experiments/<study-id>/experiment.json`
and `experiment-specs/<study-id>.json`. It is distinct from the experiment
programme family whose record is `plan.json`. The source's original experiment
ID, selected result SHA256 and reference run remain unchanged.

The selected archive carries:

- The exact ordered scientific-report edition, all original source companions,
  frozen result/CSV/export manifest, case and area choices, figures and report
  outputs.

"""Receive an unchanged archived Parameter result as an ordinary scientific source.

The archived producer owns every numerical value. No native study, run, profile
or grid is constructed in the receiving Workspace. Shared Parameter sections,
figures and the normal observed-source renderer present the preserved rows.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
from copy import deepcopy
import hashlib
import json
import math
from pathlib import Path

from .common import (atomic_bytes, atomic_json, describe_file, digest, file_digest,
                     held, identifier, now, read_json, verify_file)
from . import ensemble_scientific_source as shared
from . import parameter_report_source as live
from . import parameter_scientific_figures as figures
from . import parameter_support_reconciliation as reconciliation

SCHEMA = "upstate.parameter-result-archive-source/v1"
DIRECTORY = "parameter-archive-sources"
SOURCE_ID = "archived-parameter-result"
SOURCE_BASIS = "saved_parameter_result_archive"
RESULT_SCHEMA = "upstate.parameter-experiment-results/v1"
MASS_FIELDS = ("baseline_mass", "case_mass", "change", "percent_change",
               "baseline_full_mass", "case_full_mass")
COUNT_FIELDS = ("baseline_valid_cells", "case_valid_cells", "paired_valid_cells")
CSV_FIELDS = ("case_id", "case", "run_id", "profile_id", "area_id", "area",
              "pollutant", "units", *MASS_FIELDS, *COUNT_FIELDS, "paired_area_ha",
              "support_changed", "parameter", "baseline_parameter", "case_parameter",
              "response_per_parameter_unit", "elasticity", "pixel_area_ha",
              "baseline_valid_area_ha", "case_valid_area_ha", "overrides")


def _object(pairs):
    result = {}
    for key, value in pairs:
        if key in result:
            raise ValueError("Duplicate original JSON key: " + key)
        result[key] = value
    return result


def _nonfinite(value):
    raise ValueError("The original result contains a non-finite JSON number: " + value)


def _text(value, label):
    if not isinstance(value, str) or not value.strip():
        raise ValueError("The archived result needs its original " + label)
    return value


def _number(value, label, *, nullable=False, nonnegative=False):
    if value is None and nullable:
        return
    if (type(value) not in (int, float) or not math.isfinite(value) or
            (nonnegative and value < 0)):
        raise ValueError("The archived result has invalid " + label)


def _index(values, label, field="id"):
    if not isinstance(values, list) or not values:
        raise ValueError("The archived result needs original " + label)
    result = {}
    for row in values:
        if not isinstance(row, dict):
            raise ValueError("Invalid original " + label + " record")
        key = _text(row.get(field), label + " identity")
        if key in result:
            raise ValueError("Duplicate original " + label + " identity: " + key)
        result[key] = row
    return result


def _read(path, expected_sha256):
    expected = identifier(expected_sha256)
    raw = Path(path).read_bytes()
    actual = hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()
    if actual != expected:
        raise ValueError("The original Parameter result bytes differ from the supplied SHA256")
    result = json.loads(raw.decode("utf-8"), object_pairs_hook=_object,
                        parse_constant=_nonfinite)
    if not isinstance(result, dict) or result.get("schema") != RESULT_SCHEMA:
        raise ValueError("Select an original Parameter experiment result JSON")
    _text(result.get("workspace_id"), "donor Workspace identity")
    identifier(result.get("experiment_id"))
    _text(result.get("title"), "study title")
    _text(result.get("purpose"), "study purpose")
    selection = result.get("selection")
    baseline = result.get("baseline_selection")
    if not isinstance(selection, dict) or not isinstance(baseline, dict):
        raise ValueError("Retain the original study and baseline selections")
    identifier(selection.get("baseline_run_id"))
    for name in ("profile_id", "scenario_id", "grid_id"):
        identifier(baseline.get(name))
    cases = _index(result.get("cases"), "case")
    areas = _index(result.get("areas"), "area")
    pollutants = result.get("pollutants")
    if (not isinstance(pollutants, list) or not pollutants or
            any(not isinstance(item, str) or not item for item in pollutants) or
            len(set(pollutants)) != len(pollutants)):
        raise ValueError("Retain distinct original pollutant names")
    if (not isinstance(result.get("models"), list) or not result["models"] or
            any(not isinstance(item, str) or not item for item in result["models"])):
        raise ValueError("Retain the original model scope")
    completed = {key: row for key, row in cases.items() if row.get("state") == "complete"}
    for name in ("completed_cases", "total_cases"):
        if type(result.get(name)) is not int or result[name] < 0:
            raise ValueError("Retain the original " + name)
    if (len(completed) != result["completed_cases"] or not completed or
            result["total_cases"] < len(cases)):
        raise ValueError("Original case states disagree with the saved design counts")
    for case in cases.values():
        identifier(case.get("run_id"))
        identifier(case.get("profile_id"))
        _text(case.get("label"), "case label")
        if not isinstance(case.get("overrides"), dict):
            raise ValueError("Retain the original case overrides")
    reference_cases = [row for row in cases.values()
                       if row["run_id"] == selection["baseline_run_id"]]
    if len(reference_cases) != 1 or reference_cases[0]["profile_id"] != baseline["profile_id"]:
        raise ValueError("The archived baseline identity differs from its original case")
    for area in areas.values():
        _text(area.get("name"), "area name")
    rows = result.get("rows")
    if not isinstance(rows, list) or not rows:
        raise ValueError("The original result has no completed numeric rows")
    seen = set()
    for row in rows:
        if not isinstance(row, dict):
            raise ValueError("Invalid original numeric row")
        key = (row.get("case_id"), row.get("area_id"), row.get("pollutant"))
        if key in seen or key[0] not in completed or key[1] not in areas or key[2] not in pollutants:
            raise ValueError("Original result rows do not identify distinct completed cases and areas")
        seen.add(key)
        case = completed[key[0]]
        if any(row.get(name) != case[name] for name in ("run_id", "profile_id", "overrides")):
            raise ValueError("An original result row differs from its case selection")
        if row.get("case") != case["label"] or row.get("area") != areas[key[1]]["name"]:
            raise ValueError("An original numeric row differs from its case or area label")
        _text(row.get("units"), "physical units")
        for name in MASS_FIELDS:
            if name not in row:
                raise ValueError("Original numeric row omits " + name)
            _number(row[name], name, nullable=True)
        for name in COUNT_FIELDS:
            if type(row.get(name)) is not int or row[name] < 0:
                raise ValueError("Original valid-cell count is invalid: " + name)
        paired = row["paired_valid_cells"]
        if paired > min(row["baseline_valid_cells"], row["case_valid_cells"]):
            raise ValueError("Original paired cells exceed independent valid-cell support")
        changed = paired != row["baseline_valid_cells"] or paired != row["case_valid_cells"]
        if type(row.get("support_changed")) is not bool or row["support_changed"] != changed:
            raise ValueError("Original support flag differs from its valid-cell counts")
        _number(row.get("paired_area_ha"), "paired area", nonnegative=True)
        if not paired and any(row[name] is not None for name in
                              ("baseline_mass", "case_mass", "change", "percent_change")):
            raise ValueError("Original finite paired quantities have no common valid cells")
        if paired and any(row[name] is None for name in ("baseline_mass", "case_mass", "change")):
            raise ValueError("Original supported pair omits its stored mass or change")
        if row["baseline_mass"] == 0 and row["percent_change"] is not None:
            raise ValueError("Original percentage has a zero paired baseline")
        for name, count in (("baseline_full_mass", "baseline_valid_cells"),
                            ("case_full_mass", "case_valid_cells")):
            if (row[name] is None) != (row[count] == 0):
                raise ValueError("Original own-valid mass disagrees with its valid-cell support")
    expected_rows = {(case, area, pollutant) for case in completed for area in areas
                     for pollutant in pollutants}
    if seen != expected_rows:
        raise ValueError("The archive omits part of its declared completed result matrix")
    return raw, result


def _selection(workspace, result, value, actual_sha256):
    cases = [row for row in result["cases"] if row["state"] == "complete"]
    case_ids = live._choices(value.get("case_ids"), [row["id"] for row in cases], "archived cases")
    area_ids = live._choices(value.get("area_ids"), [row["id"] for row in result["areas"]], "archived areas")
    pollutants = live._choices(value.get("pollutants"), result["pollutants"], "archived pollutants")
    title = _text(value.get("title") or ("Archived Parameter study: " + result["title"]), "report title")
    selected = {
        "selection": {"edition": 1, "source_basis": SOURCE_BASIS,
                      "experiment_id": result["experiment_id"],
                      "workspace_id": result["workspace_id"],
                      "receiving_workspace_id": workspace.project["id"], "title": title,
                      "expected_artifact_sha256": actual_sha256, "case_ids": case_ids,
                      "area_ids": area_ids, "pollutants": pollutants},
        "cases": deepcopy([row for row in cases if row["id"] in case_ids]),
        "areas": deepcopy([row for row in result["areas"] if row["id"] in area_ids]),
        "models": deepcopy(result["models"]), "pollutants": pollutants,
        "completed_cases": result["completed_cases"], "total_cases": result["total_cases"],
        "includes_all_completed_cases": len(case_ids) == len(cases),
        "reference": {"run_id": result["selection"]["baseline_run_id"],
                      **{name: result["baseline_selection"][name]
                         for name in ("profile_id", "scenario_id", "grid_id")},
                      "run_selection": deepcopy(result["baseline_selection"])},
        "comparison_basis": _text(result.get("comparison_basis"), "comparison basis"),
        "range_basis": (
            "Historical range records remain unchanged in original-result.json and historical-ranges.json. "
            "They are not displayed as current completed-case ranges. This archived intake does not "
            "recalculate them or assume that their producer included the reference case."),
    }
    rows = deepcopy([row for row in result["rows"] if row["case_id"] in case_ids and
                     row["area_id"] in area_ids and row["pollutant"] in pollutants])
    selected["selected_rows"] = len(rows)
    return selected, rows


def _sections(result, selected, rows, origin_uri, original_bytes):
    sections = live._sections(selected, rows, [])
    # Reuse the maintained scientific tables, replacing only its live-export claim.
    expected = "Original files and spatial interpretation"
    if not sections or sections[-1][0] != expected:
        raise ValueError("The maintained Parameter report sections changed; review the archive integration")
    sections.pop()
    runtime = result.get("native_versions")
    runtime_labels = result.get("native_version_labels")
    prefix = [["Archived original result and source interpretation", [
        "This source receives the unchanged output of an original saved Parameter study. "
        "Its case rows retain the donor Workspace, native run, profile, scenario and grid identities. "
        "The receiving Workspace edits report selection and presentation while the original bytes remain frozen.",
        live._table(["Original identity", "Retained value"], [
            ["Donor Workspace", result["workspace_id"]],
            ["Receiving Workspace", selected["selection"]["receiving_workspace_id"]],
            ["Study", result["experiment_id"]],
            ["Original result SHA256", selected["selection"]["expected_artifact_sha256"]],
            ["Original result bytes", original_bytes],
            ["Original source location", origin_uri or "Unspecified"],
            ["Original requested InVEST version", result["baseline_selection"].get("invest_version")],
            ["Original actual runtime versions", runtime if runtime else "Not retained in this archived result"],
            ["Original actual runtime labels", runtime_labels if runtime_labels else "Not retained in this archived result"],
            ["Original requested difference maps", result["selection"].get("difference_maps", "Unspecified")],
        ]),
        "The requested version and embedded versions in coefficient-source references are different kinds "
        "of provenance. Missing executed-runtime records remain explicitly missing. Native model inputs, "
        "rasters and editable donor studies remain with their original owners; this package retains the "
        "exact numeric result and its recorded provenance.",
        live._table(["Original method", "Retained description"], [
            [key, result.get(key)] for key in
            ("mass_basis", "aggregation_extent", "comparison_basis", "range_basis", "design")]),
        live._table(["Original coefficient-source provenance", "Retained value"], [
            [key, value] for key, value in result.get("coefficient_source", {}).items()]),
    ]]]
    methods = [section for section in sections if section[0] in {
        "Saved Parameter result selection", "Original fixed baseline and case key",
        "Reporting geography", "Original completed-case range selection"}]
    findings = [section for section in sections if section not in methods]
    overview = [[result["title"] + " — scientific findings", [
        result["purpose"],
        str(result["completed_cases"]) + " of " + str(result["total_cases"]) +
        " original cases are complete; " + str(len(selected["selection"]["case_ids"])) +
        " completed cases are selected here. Each constituent retains its original annual-mass unit.",
        "The values below are original modeled annual export. Signed change is case minus baseline "
        "on the cells valid in both runs. Negative change means lower modeled export. "
        "This is a parameter/routing comparison with the original land-cover scenario held fixed.",
    ]]]
    for area in selected["areas"]:
        for pollutant in selected["selection"]["pollutants"]:
            values = [row for row in rows if row["area_id"] == area["id"] and
                      row["pollutant"] == pollutant]
            overview.append([area["name"] + " / " + pollutant.replace("_export", "") +
                             " — original paired comparison", [
                live._table(["Original case", "Units", "Paired change", "Change (%)",
                             "Common area (ha)", "Support changed"], [
                    [row["case"], row["units"], row["change"],
                     row["percent_change"] if row["percent_change"] is not None else
                     ("Undefined: no paired cells" if not row["paired_valid_cells"] else
                      "Undefined: zero paired baseline" if row["baseline_mass"] == 0 else
                      "Undefined in original result"),
                     row["paired_area_ha"], row["support_changed"]] for row in values]),
            ]])
    # The maintained shared sections include source-bound support reconciliation
    # and the single-assumption sign-reversal example; do not create a second reducer.
    sections = overview + findings + [["Methods, original selection and source provenance", [
        "The following appendix retains the original identities, selections, source editions, "
        "geographic methods and historical-range policy used for the figures and numeric tables."
    ]]] + methods + prefix
    sections.append(["Original archive, selected rows and figure provenance", [
        "The original complete JSON is attached byte for byte. Selected row values are copied unchanged; "
        "each selected row maps to its original JSON row index in archive-provenance.json. "
        "Historical range rows are retained verbatim as a companion, with their original stated basis. "
        "Original map requests are reported above; this receiving operation does not create a missing raster.",
        {"kind": "links", "items": [
            {"title": "Complete unchanged original result", "path": "original-result.json"},
            {"title": "Original identity, source basis and row mapping", "path": "archive-provenance.json"},
            {"title": "Selected original numeric rows", "path": "selected-results.json"},
            {"title": "Selected rows for working analysis", "path": "selected-results.csv"},
            {"title": "Historical original ranges and stated basis", "path": "historical-ranges.json"},
        ]},
    ]])
    return sections


def _package(directory, raw, result, selected, rows, origin_uri):
    atomic_bytes(directory / "original-result.json", raw, immutable=True)
    atomic_json(directory / "selection.json", selected, immutable=True)
    atomic_json(directory / "selected-results.json", {
        "schema": "upstate.selected-parameter-results/v1", "selection": selected["selection"],
        "rows": rows, "ranges": [], "range_basis": selected["range_basis"]}, immutable=True)
    shared._csv(directory, "selected-results.csv", rows, CSV_FIELDS)
    atomic_json(directory / "historical-ranges.json", {
        "source_basis": SOURCE_BASIS, "original_result_sha256": selected["selection"]["expected_artifact_sha256"],
        "range_basis": result.get("range_basis"), "ranges": result.get("ranges", []),
        "display_policy": selected["range_basis"]}, immutable=True)
    indices = {(row["case_id"], row["area_id"], row["pollutant"]): index
               for index, row in enumerate(result["rows"])}
    provenance = {
        "schema": "upstate.parameter-result-archive-provenance/v1", "source_basis": SOURCE_BASIS,
        "donor_workspace_id": result["workspace_id"], "experiment_id": result["experiment_id"],
        "original_sha256": selected["selection"]["expected_artifact_sha256"],
        "original_bytes": len(raw), "origin_uri": origin_uri,
        "original_selection": deepcopy(result["selection"]),
        "original_baseline_selection": deepcopy(result["baseline_selection"]),
        "native_runtime_metadata_present": {
            name: name in result for name in ("native_versions", "native_version_labels", "native_run_selections")},
        "row_mapping": [{"selected_row": index, "original_row": indices[
            (row["case_id"], row["area_id"], row["pollutant"])],
            "case_id": row["case_id"], "area_id": row["area_id"], "pollutant": row["pollutant"]}
            for index, row in enumerate(rows)],
    }
    atomic_json(directory / "archive-provenance.json", provenance, immutable=True)
    records = [{"id": SOURCE_ID, "title": result["title"], "uri": origin_uri,
                "vintage": "Original archived result " + provenance["original_sha256"],
                "body_sha256": provenance["original_sha256"]}]
    atomic_json(directory / "original-source-editions.json", records, immutable=True)
    reconciliation.write(directory, selected, rows, original_rows=result["rows"], origin_uri=origin_uri)
    graphics = figures.write(directory, selected, rows)
    sections = _sections(result, selected, rows, origin_uri, len(raw))
    sections.append(["Original figure coverage", [
        "Every physical coordinate is copied from a selected original row. Undefined values remain "
        "in the coverage inventory. Case positions are presentation keys, not parameter magnitudes.",
        live._table(["Selected rows", "Figures", "Plotted values", "Undefined values"], [[
            graphics["coverage"][name] for name in
            ("selected_rows", "figure_count", "plotted_values", "undefined_values")]]),
        {"kind": "links", "items": [
            {"title": "Figure specification", "path": figures.SPEC},
            {"title": "Original numeric coordinates", "path": figures.COORDINATES},
            {"title": "Figure coverage", "path": figures.COVERAGE}]},
    ]])
    members = [describe_file(directory, path) for path in sorted(directory.rglob("*"))
               if path.is_file() and path not in
               {directory / "sources.json", directory / "scientific-report.json"}]
    recipe = {"schema": shared.RECIPE_SCHEMA, "title": selected["selection"]["title"],
              "edition": selected["selection"]["expected_artifact_sha256"], "basis": selected,
              "sections": sections, "figure_spec": graphics["figure_spec"],
              "figures": graphics["figures"], "figure_coverage": graphics["coverage"],
              "inputs": members, "source_links": [row["path"] for row in members]}
    atomic_json(directory / "scientific-report.json", recipe, immutable=True)
    atomic_json(directory / "sources.json", {
        "schema": "upstate.sources/v1", "title": recipe["title"], "entries": [{
            "id": SOURCE_ID, "kind": "document", "role": shared.ROLE, "title": recipe["title"],
            "path": "scientific-report.json", "sha256": file_digest(directory / "scientific-report.json"),
            "uri": "urn:upstate:parameter-result-archive:" + provenance["original_sha256"],
            "vintage": records[0]["vintage"], "units": "Original annual mass and paired valid-cell support",
            "metadata": {"report_schema": shared.RECIPE_SCHEMA, "source_basis": SOURCE_BASIS,
                         "donor_workspace_id": result["workspace_id"],
                         "experiment_id": result["experiment_id"],
                         "original_result_sha256": provenance["original_sha256"]},
            "companions": [{"path": row["path"], "sha256": row["sha256"]} for row in members],
        }]}, immutable=True)
    return records


def get(workspace, operation_id):
    key = identifier(operation_id)
    directory = workspace.root / DIRECTORY / key
    operation = read_json(directory / "operation.json")
    if (operation.get("schema") != SCHEMA or operation.get("id") != key or
            operation.get("workspace_id") != workspace.project["id"] or
            digest(operation.get("identity")) != key or
            operation.get("selection") != operation["identity"].get("selection")):
        raise ValueError("The archived scientific source belongs to another receiving selection")
    for descriptor in operation.get("files", {}).values():
        verify_file(workspace.root, descriptor)
    if operation.get("source"):
        workspace.source_file(operation["source"]["source_collection_id"], SOURCE_ID)
    return operation


def prepare(workspace, result_path, *, expected_sha256, selection=None, origin_uri="", render=True):
    """Import exact original bytes, preserve donor identities and optionally render."""
    if type(render) is not bool or (selection is not None and not isinstance(selection, dict)):
        raise ValueError("Choose an archived result selection and boolean render option")
    if not isinstance(origin_uri, str):
        raise ValueError("Original source location must be text")
    raw, original = _read(result_path, expected_sha256)
    selected, rows = _selection(workspace, original, selection or {}, expected_sha256)
    identity = {"schema": SCHEMA, "selection": selected["selection"], "origin_uri": origin_uri,
                "producer_sha256": file_digest(Path(__file__)),
                "sections_sha256": file_digest(Path(live.__file__)),
                "figure_helper_sha256": file_digest(Path(figures.__file__)),
                "figure_svg_helper_sha256": file_digest(Path(figures.drawing.__file__)),
                "support_reconciliation_sha256": file_digest(Path(reconciliation.__file__))}
    key = digest(identity)
    directory = workspace.root / DIRECTORY / key
    directory.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    with held(directory / ".prepare.lock", blocking=False):
        record = directory / "operation.json"
        operation = read_json(record) if record.exists() else {
            "schema": SCHEMA, "id": key, "identity": identity,
            "workspace_id": workspace.project["id"], "donor_workspace_id": original["workspace_id"],
            "experiment_id": original["experiment_id"], "selection": selected["selection"],
            "source_basis": SOURCE_BASIS, "title": selected["selection"]["title"],
            "created_at": now(), "state": "preparing", "files": {}}
        if operation.get("identity") != identity:
            raise ValueError("Existing archive operation has another original selection")
        source = directory / "source"
        source.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        try:
            if not (source / "sources.json").exists():
                _package(source, raw, original, selected, rows, origin_uri)
            recipe = read_json(source / "scientific-report.json")
            if recipe.get("basis") != selected:
                raise ValueError("Existing archive recipe has another original selection")
            for member in recipe["inputs"]:
                verify_file(source, member)
            if not operation.get("source"):
                collection = workspace.import_sources(source / "sources.json")
                operation["source"] = {"source_collection_id": collection["id"], "source_id": SOURCE_ID}
                operation["state"] = "source_ready"
                atomic_json(record, operation)
            else:
                workspace.source_file(operation["source"]["source_collection_id"], SOURCE_ID)
            if render:
                operation["report"] = shared._render(workspace, directory, operation,
                    read_json(source / "original-source-editions.json"))
                operation["files"].update(operation["report"]["files"])
                operation["state"] = "complete"
            for name in ("sources.json", "scientific-report.json", "original-result.json",
                         "selected-results.json", "selected-results.csv", "archive-provenance.json",
                         "historical-ranges.json", figures.SPEC, figures.COORDINATES, figures.COVERAGE,
                         *reconciliation.FILES):
                operation["files"][name] = describe_file(workspace.root, source / name)
            operation["delivery_selection"] = shared.delivery_selection(operation["source"])
            operation["figure_count"] = len(recipe.get("figures", []))
            operation.pop("error", None)
            operation["updated_at"] = now()
            atomic_json(record, operation)
            return get(workspace, key)
        except BaseException as error:
            operation.update(state="source_ready" if operation.get("source") else "failed",
                             error={"type": type(error).__name__, "message": str(error)}, updated_at=now())
            atomic_json(record, operation)
            raise


def main(argv=None):
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("--workspace", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--result", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--expected-sha256", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--origin-uri", default="")
    parser.add_argument("--selection", help="Optional JSON containing case_ids, area_ids, pollutants or title")
    parser.add_argument("--source-only", action="store_true")
    parser.add_argument("--output", help="Write the completed operation record at this path")
    args = parser.parse_args(argv)
    from .workspace import Workspace
    result = prepare(Workspace(args.workspace), args.result, expected_sha256=args.expected_sha256,
                     selection=read_json(Path(args.selection)) if args.selection else None,
                     origin_uri=args.origin_uri, render=not args.source_only)
    if args.output:
        atomic_json(Path(args.output), result)
    print(json.dumps(result, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2, allow_nan=False))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

# Archived Parameter result → scientific report

This entry receives an original, completed Parameter result JSON into the current application's ordinary scientific-source collection. It reuses the maintained Parameter tables and figures and the shared PDF/HTML/Markdown formatter. The report opens with the scientific purpose and original per-case paired findings, followed by the actual mass/support tables. Detailed identities and coefficient provenance appear in its methods/source appendix. The receiving Workspace can select cases, areas and pollutants and compose this source alongside its other reports.

The archived original JSON remains byte-for-byte unchanged. Its donor Workspace, experiment, run, profile, scenario and grid IDs remain donor identities. The receiving operation creates a source collection and report, without creating a donor experiment or native run. Metadata uses `source_basis=saved_parameter_result_archive`, distinct from the live editable Parameter study source.

## Receive and open the actual original Gura result

Use an existing current application and its receiving Workspace. The retained original result is included at `receiving/gura-original-four-case-results.json`:

```sh
python -B -m model.parameter_archive_source \
  --workspace /actual/current/workspace \
  --result receiving/gura-original-four-case-results.json \
  --expected-sha256 20a0f25d11742011784ac3bcae7857de108b244adaee8ceae7a79f9a921eaa9b \
  --origin-uri https://tokenjunkielabs.slack.com/docs/T0BRETUB5TK/F0C8KE9N5U3 \
  --output /actual/owned/gura-archived-source.json
```

Run from the application root so the maintained model modules are imported. The existing Python environment needs the application's normal scientific-report dependencies; this course does not invoke InVEST or raster aggregation. Keep ongoing regional calculations and their workspaces running.

The output record identifies the receiving operation, source collection/source ID, report members, original-result companion and delivery selection. Its `files` descriptors are relative to the actual receiving Workspace. Open the exact `report.pdf`, `report.html`, `report.md`, `report-data.json`, selection and `scientific-report.zip` paths from that record. The archive includes the collected original source members. Inspect and use the exact numeric CSV and figure coordinate files as well as the rendered report and SVG figures.

To edit the report selection, pass `--selection selection.json`, containing any of `case_ids`, `area_ids`, `pollutants` and `title`. Choices must be original available identities; output follows the original case order. Excluding the baseline display case retains the original baseline reference for every comparison. Another selection yields another immutable report operation, leaving the earlier edition available. `--source-only` imports the source without rendering it; a later identical call without that option completes the existing operation.

The Python API is:

```python

from model.ensemble_scientific_source import delivery_selection

received = prepare(
    workspace, original_result_path,
    expected_sha256=original_sha256,
    origin_uri=original_location,

)

    received["source"], previous=current_delivery_selection

The complete imported source collection carries the frozen recipe and every original companion through the ordinary source/Study transfer. Reopen the receiving application and its source selection, then render from the retained source collection; the original input-file path is unnecessary for that ordinary composer operation. Re-running this CLI requires the exact original input bytes, which remain available in the imported source's `original-result.json` companion.

## What the recovered Gura study says

The archived result is exactly 17,291 bytes with the SHA256 in the command above. It was recovered from the original 6A4E source Canvas, JSON block containing `receiving/ndr-original-four-case-results.json`. Donor Workspace:

`5afb21c0-0894-4476-b620-24b81fc9fe93`

Completed NDR study:

`0bde5ae5a60805b8a39e119a910f131ad72977aeaac00dfdd4d0c030713b30c2`

This NDR study completed **four of four original cases**, producing eight N/P rows. The wider original suite `ac52dfce004b9ecd4301b90d1f0d62c192684da0e00f66111cbcebaf5083b22a` also contains an interrupted SDR arm. The completed NDR case count must not be described as a four-case partial NDR study.

The landscape and grid are fixed. The factorial design changes NDR connectivity shape `k_param` between 1 and 2 and routing between MFD and D8. The original baseline is MFD with k=2. These are parameter/routing sensitivities of the original Gura case, separate from the Upper Savannah restoration programme and the current simulated headwaters demonstration.

All values below are original stored annual export values in **kg/year**. The human table rounds for readability; the report, selected CSV, coordinates and original JSON preserve the stored values.

| Original case | N paired change | N paired change (%) | P paired change | P paired change (%) | Paired valid cells |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| MFD, k=2 baseline | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 458,967 |
| MFD, k=1 | +530.541260 | +3.543577 | +273.292865 | +4.705594 | 458,967 |
| D8, k=1 | −770.452692 | −5.180707 | −156.980436 | −2.721641 | 456,304 |
| D8, k=2 | −725.147087 | −4.876061 | −222.385100 | −3.855591 | 456,304 |

Changes are **case minus baseline on each pair's common valid cells**. Negative means lower modeled export. The MFD pairs share the baseline's 458,967 valid cells, covering 10,326.7575 ha. D8 cases have 471,219 own-valid cells and 456,304 common cells, covering 10,266.84 ha on the common support. Their common baseline masses consequently differ from the MFD comparisons.

The baseline own-valid total is 14,971.911478747614 kg N/year. D8, k=2 has an own-valid N total of 15,188.786561910994 kg/year, while its **paired** N change is −725.147086863406 kg/year. The differing support explains why the independent totals and common-cell comparison can point in different directions. The scientific report puts both quantities beside their original cell counts.

For MFD k=1 the parameter step from the original baseline is negative (1 minus 2). Its positive mass change therefore has a negative stored response per parameter unit. That is the original finite-step sensitivity, not a fitted derivative. Categorical routing and multi-parameter cases have no single numeric response.

The original result predates the maintained range-producer correction: its stored ranges exclude the baseline and show one eligible MFD alternative. Before receiving, the adapter verifies the caller-supplied SHA256 against the exact file bytes and rejects duplicate JSON keys, missing original identities, invalid numbers, duplicate matrix rows, mismatched case/run/profile assignments and inconsistent original support counts. The source operation pins the archived bytes, report selection, adapter, maintained section producer, support reconciliation helper and figure helper source identities.
